articleTitle: An Abnormal Detection Method of Electric Power Equipment Based on Contrast Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the widespread application of Industrial Control Systems (ICS), equipment anomaly detection has become crucial for ensuring safety and reliability. Traditional detection methods rely on predefined rules and thresholds, which often lack accuracy and adaptability when faced with complex network attacks and equipment failures. To address this issue, this paper proposes an anomaly detection method based on contrastive learning. By incorporating data augmentation techniques (such as timestamp perturbation, field masking, noise addition, etc.), the method reduces reliance on large amounts of labeled data and enhances model robustness. Additionally, deep neural networks (such as CNNs and Transformers) are used for feature extraction, enabling the model to capture more complex anomaly patterns. The paper also combines classification loss with contrastive loss, improving the model's ability to distinguish between normal and abnormal samples in the feature space, thus enhancing detection accuracy and reliability. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method performs well in anomaly detection tasks within industrial control systems, showing promising potential for real-world applications.

articleTitle: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation via Contrastive Inversion and Cluster Alignment
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Data-free knowledge distillation (DFKD) aims to transfer the knowledge from a large teacher network to a lightweight student network without accessing the original training data. However, existing DFKD methods face the issue of distribution shift during data synthesis, which leads to a decline in knowledge distillation. To address this issue, we propose a data-free knowledge distillation method (CCD) based on contrastive inversion (CI) and cluster alignment (CA). Specifically, CI enables the generative network to better capture relevant features and efficiently synthesize images that conforms to the original training data. However, using CI alone can severely reduce the diversity of synthesis images, which may lead to poor performance of the student network. Thus, we propose CA to assure the generative network can learn not only intra-class feature but also the inter-class feature to alleviate the diversity issue. The experiments on various dataset show that our proposed method outperform other baseline methods.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Side Response Pricing Mechanism Based on Fuzzy Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The implementation of demand-side response needs to rely on a reasonable incentive mechanism to mobilize user participation through dynamic pricing or compensation strategies. On this basis, this paper proposes a dynamic pricing model for demand-side response based on Fuzzy Reinforcement Learning (FRL) to solve the problems of complexity of user behavior and response uncertainty in the power system. By combining fuzzy logic and reinforcement learning methods, the model dynamically optimizes the electricity pricing strategy on the basis of dealing with fuzzy variables such as user price sensitivity and load shedding willingness. The simulation results show that the FRL model outperforms the traditional fixed pricing mechanism in demand response, and at the same time, it can effectively reduce the operating cost of the power grid, enhance the economic benefits of users and their motivation to participate in demand response, and provide an intelligent solution for the efficient operation and economy of the power system.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Multi Physical Field Coupling Mechanism of Surface Discharge of Contaminated Insulators
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Accumulation and adhesion of pollution on the surface of insulators can easily cause electric field distortion, reduce their insulation performance, lead to flashover, and seriously threaten the safe and stable operation of transmission lines. This article comprehensively considers the coupling effects of multiple physical fields such as electric field, magnetic field, flow field, and temperature field, and establishes a finite element simulation model of insulators by combining the Auburn Snow model and magnetohydrodynamics. Research has shown that polluted dry areas have a more significant distortion effect on the electric field, with an overall “V” shape in the electric field distribution. The electric field strength of large umbrella skirts is higher than that of small umbrella skirts, and the changes in current density and temperature are similar. This study deepens the understanding of surface discharge of contaminated insulators.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Perception and Monitoring Technology for Large-Scale Landslides
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In large-scale landslide disaster monitoring, the shortcomings of sampling time and data details that caused by the traditional equal time interval sampling and non-differential collection methods, which makes it difficult to meet the real-time perception of abnormal changes in disaster. To resolve these issues, this paper proposes a method for intelligent sensing monitoring of large landslides based on adaptive data collection. The overall structure design and software and hardware design scheme of intelligent perception monitoring technology are introduced in detail. The designed adaptive data acquisition strategy has a good ability to capture the abnormal changes of landslide monitoring parameters, which provides a better alternative monitoring scheme for real-time data collection of disaster body status. Moreover, it can provide effective data guarantee for the research of large-scale landslide disaster intelligent monitoring and disaster prediction.

articleTitle: Efficient Energy Dispatching for User-Load Smart Nano-Grids
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: User-Load Smart Nano-Grids (UL-SNGs) are localized and small-scale energy networks designed to efficiently manage generation, storage, and consumption at a local level. The UL-SN G integrates photovoltaic (PV) devices, energy storage (ES) units, and flexible load demand with advanced control and communication techniques. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimal energy dispatching system framework where multiple UL-SNGs are interconnected to actively participate in the demand response (DR) within the large and small timescale energy scheduling. First, an optimal energy dispatching control DR strategy is proposed as a large-timescale energy scheduling, specifically an incentive mechanism for UL-SNGs to participate in DR. Then, to improve real-time PV utilization and ensure the operational stability of ES energy among UL-SNGs, a Lyapunov-based real-time energy optimization (LREO) algorithm is designed as a small-timescale energy scheduling. Finally, a MATLAB simulation model is developed using accurate UL-SNG profiles to evaluate the effectiveness of the optimized energy dispatching control strategy. The numerical results improve the optimization of the energy dispatching and real-time PV utilization, ensuring the stabilized ES queue operation among the UL-SNGs DR.

articleTitle: LSTM Based Data Association for Radar Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In complex tracking scenarios, traditional target tracking methods cannot solve the problem of data association. This article proposes a data association method based on LSTM to address this issue. This method is an end-to-end approach that can automatically learn association criteria through annotated samples, resulting in higher accuracy in data association in complex tracking scenarios. Two simulation experiments are carried out and they can show the better performance of our method.

articleTitle: A Dual-Side-Detuned Series–Series Compensated Inductive Power Transfer System with Plane Misalignment Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In inductive power transfer (IPT) systems, maintaining a stable output when the coils are significantly misaligned remains a challenge. The design of detuned circuits is considered one of the effective solutions to address this issue. However, in previous studies, commonly used unipolar coils exhibit a rapid decrease in coupling coefficient when misalignment occurs, which limits the system's tolerance to misalignment. To overcome this limitation, this paper establishes a mathematical model of the bilateral detuned series–series (S-S) topology and theoretically analyzes the relationship between the detuning factor and output fluctuations. Based on this, a cascade coil composed of unipolar and quadrupole coils is used to meet the required specifications. This effectively reduces output fluctuations during misalignment. Experimental results indicate that when the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$X$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Y$</tex> directions are within 50% of the coil size, the system's output fluctuation is only 1.28%.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for Multi Hybrid Active Power Filters
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the development of new power systems and power electronics technology, the power system in the “double high” scenario faces certain challenges in harmonic control. To achieve precise real-time control of harmonics, this article proposes a collaborative control strategy for multi hybrid active power filters (HAPF). Based on Silicon Carbide Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor (SiC-MOSFET) novel power components, a modular HAPF was constructed, the active and passive parts were connected through coupling inductance to output effective compensation current. To achieve real-time and accurate detection of harmonics, an adaptive filter is constructed by combining Least Mean Square (LMS) and Least Mean Squared (LMF) method, and adaptively update the weight step size based on the error results. A coupling evaluation index was constructed by introducing the relative gain matrix (RGA), considering the compensation performance, capacity allocation, and coupling effects of each HAPF, the optimal allocation of compensation current for each device is determined. The simulation results showed that the proposed method can accurately detect and compensate for system harmonics through collaborative control of multiple HAPF, thereby improving the power quality of the power system.

articleTitle: Reliable Aggregation Optimization Technology for Large-Scale Variable Frequency Air Conditioning Load Under Multiple Rotation Control
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The difficulty of smoothing the output fluctuations of large-scale variable frequency air conditioners is affected by the power supply pressure during peak hours, resulting in low stability of variable frequency loads. In order to ensure the comfort of users' electricity consumption, a reliable aggregation optimization technology for large-scale variable frequency air conditioner loads under multiple rotation control is proposed. Set up thermodynamic models, electric thermal conversion models, and comfort models to describe individual air conditioning load characteristics, comprehensively consider the physical characteristics of air conditioning equipment, user comfort requirements, and power system scheduling needs, calculate the longest rotation period that meets temperature fluctuation requirements, solve the aggregation power expectation function based on priority, and optimize the reliable aggregation results of large-scale variable frequency air conditioning loads by combining the overall aggregation power. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a maximum of 1.2 or above in the load response consistency index, and the load fluctuation is effectively controlled. Optimize the load aggregation of large-scale variable frequency air conditioning to enhance the stability and operational efficiency of the power system.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on Improved Long and Short-Term Memory Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is affected by weather and geographical environment, which presents fluctuation and random multi-interference, so predicting the output power is crucial to optimize the grid-connected operation of photovoltaic power generation and reduce the influence of uncertainties. Based on the deep learning theory, this paper proposes an improved long short-term memory neural network photovoltaic power prediction method. Irradiance, temperature, pressure, humidity data and historical photovoltaic power are selected as the characteristic data of the model, which is used as the input of the neural network to predict the power value of photovoltaic power at the next moment, and introduce the RMSProp algorithm to obtain the optimal loss function value of the model, ensuring the best prediction results. The simulation results demonstrate that the model has good prediction accuracy.

Author Keywords: Long and short-term memory neural network

articleTitle: The Highest Priority Setting Method of Power System Dispatching Based on Time Series
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In the process of power system dispatching, the automatic issuing instruction are divided into multiple priority levels according to the different time requirements of the task. Usually, different priority tasks do not disturb each other and are executed in an orderly manner according to the set parameters. However, there are many disturbance factors in the actual state, which will bias the time threshold in the priority division process, leading to serious problems such as delay in scheduling instructions and wrong instruction priority setting process. In order to reduce the probability of setting method errors, solve the above problems, according to the priority processing principle, the set parameter time variable optimization, optimization based on the time series, through the time sequence of power system scheduling instruction clustering, scheduling instruction automation incremental time series clustering calculation, scheduling instruction highest priority calculation and scheduling automation of the highest priority based on time series, complete the global setting parameter optimization. Through the comparison of simulation data, the results show that the proposed setting method has the effect of optimizing the setting parameter time relationship, improving the instruction priority task processing efficiency, and reducing the grouping error. The overall feasibility and adaptability make it have a good research and promotion value.

articleTitle: Electricity Spot Market Supervision Risk Assessment Model in a Provincial Level
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The electricity spot market has great superiorities in promotion of renewable energy consumption, optimization of electricity resource allocation and the reinforcement of power system stability. Considering various risk and challenges in high-quality supervision and promotion. This paper aims to identify critical risk criteria of provincial electricity spot market supervision through a novel criteria identification, evaluation and response strategy system to ensure secure and optimal functioning of the provincial electricity spot market. Firstly, risk criteria of provincial electricity spot market supervision are identified through literature review and expert consultation from five perspectives tailored to the characteristics of the provincial electricity spot market in China. Considering uncertainty and redundancy existing in subjective risk identification, the Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is introduced to refine original DEMATEL method to remove redundancy risk, further analyzing comprehensive importance and causal relationship. Additionally, a case study is conducted. The results show that spot price volatility, impact of regulatory measures, and electricity load balance are key risk criteria. The results have a guiding role for both governmental regulations and enterprise practices in dealing with the risks. Finally, corresponding supervision measures are formulated to mitigate or eliminate these key criteria.

Author Keywords: provincial electricity spot market supervision risk

articleTitle: Detection of Beer Bottle Caps with Defects Based on Improved ShuffleNet V2
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Beer bottle caps are produced in large quantities. In addition, beer bottle caps with defects not only affect the customer's experience, but also may not protect the beer effectively. Therefore, it is important to detect defects in beer bottle caps quickly, efficiently and accurately. Deploying convolutional neural network (CNN) on field programmable gate array (FPGA) can achieve the above objectives. However, CNN generally has a large number of parameters and high complexity, in addition, CNN operates differently among different hardware devices. In order to solve the problems, this paper improves the ShuffleN et V2 so that the model is suitable to be deployed on FPGA, and runs fast on FPGA. The improved methods are shown below: firstly, we reduce the number of output channels in the Conv5 module. After that, we replace the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\times 1$</tex> ordinary convolutions of the right branch in the ShuffleNet V2 Unit1 and Unit2 with the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\times 1$</tex> group convolutions, and add the channel shuffle after the first group convolution. Finally, we replace the convolution operations of the left branch in the ShuffleN et V2 U nit2 with the max pooling. Experiments show that our proposed model not only reduces the number of parameters and the complexity of the model, but also improves the accuracy and the f1-score of the model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Oscillations in Wind Farms Integrated into the Grid Through Flexible Direct Current Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As the share of renewable energy in the power supply grows, power system oscillations are escalating in severity. This paper analyzes the oscillation problem of a direct-drive wind farm connected to the power grid through a voltage source converter based high-voltage direct current transmission system (VSC-HVDC). First, a small signal model is constructed based on modular principles, and the eigenvalue analysis method is applied to solve the state matrix of the entire system to determine the oscillation mode in the system. Secondly, the main factors affecting the subsynchronous oscillations are investigated by the methods of participation factor analysis. Finally, the subsynchronous oscillation is suppressed by optimizing the parameters of the controller at the network side, and the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the suppression strategy are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-Attention Enhanced Segmentation Network for Medical Image
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In clinical medicine, accurate segmentation of organ contour is the prerequisite for assisting doctors in diagnosis and precise radiotherapy. In order to improve the problem that U-Net network caused by the local nature of convolution operation can only acquire local features in medical image segmentation, and it is difficult to capture global context information, an multi-attention enhanced segmentation network (MAESN et) for medical image. The network is based on a U-Net network and consists of a convolutional block attention module (CBAM) and an attention-enhancing skip connection (AESC) module. The CBAM module recalibrates and enhances the features from two dimensions of channel and spatial perform adaptive feature optimization, the attention enhancement skip connection module replaces the skip connection, fuses the multi-level features from the encoder, effectively integrates the feature information of different scales, bridges the semantic gap between the encoder and the decoder, and strengthens the global dependency. Comparison experiments and ablation experiments were performed on the own dataset, and the results showed that MAESNet achieved 81.60% in DSC and 26.04 in HD, respectively, effectively improving the segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on the Development of Discharge Pattern of Defect in Resin-Impregnated Paper Bushing Materials
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Resin-impregnated paper(RIP) capacitive bushing is one of the important electrical equipment in the field of high-voltage power transmission. However, there is a lack of research on the change rule of insulation parameters under long-term operating conditions of the RIP bushing containing internal defect and the diagnosis of insulation defect of the RIP bushing. For the laboratory casting of RIP specimens containing metal foreign object defect, non-metal foreign object defect and bubble defect three types of specimens were studied in the partial discharge starting voltage and constant voltage long time defect in the process of the development of the characteristics of the discharge spectrum, comparing the discharge before and after the development of the tanδ-f curve of the law of change, in which the starting voltage of local discharge for metal foreign object defect is 10.2 kV, the starting voltage of local discharge for non-metal foreign object defect is 14.1 kV, and the starting voltage of local discharge for bubble defect is 13.7 kV. The discharge of metal foreign object defect undergoes two phases of increasing discharge frequency and increasing discharge amount, the discharge amount of non-metal foreign object defect is always maintained at 300–400 pC during the development of discharge, and the discharge phase gradually becomes wider with the increase of the withstand time, and finally becomes all-phase discharge, and the discharge amount of the bubble defect specimens increases gradually with the increase of the withstand time during the development of discharge, and the discharge peaks appear at 112.5°-157.5° and 292.5°-337.5° subsequently. °-157.5° and 292.5°-337.5° discharge peaks. According to the above specimen discharge development research results, for the RIP bushing long time defect discharge development research to provide the experimental basis.

articleTitle: Application and Analysis of Automatic Tuning Arc Suppression Coil in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper describes the importance of auto-tuned arc suppression coil in power grid operation. Compared with the traditional arc suppression coil which relied on manual adjustment, automatic tracking arc suppression coil is convenient to adjust and accurate to select the gear during operation. It can avoid the formation of series resonance with full compensation after line tripping and overcome the previous shortcomings [1]. Through theoretical analysis, the addition of damping resistance can reduce the neutral point displacement voltage, and the suitable damping resistance value is calculated theoretically, and applied in practical cases, so that the neutral point voltage of 66kV north bus line of DD 220kV substation can be reduced to the ideal value, eliminating the false grounding, system resonance and other faults caused by excessive neutral point displacement voltage, and improving the power supply quality. It also provides a reference for the wide application of auto-tuned arc suppression coil in power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Overheating Identification Technology for Substation Equipment Area Based on Infrared and Visible Light Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The overheating problem of substation equipment is one of the main factors leading to equipment failure and power interruption. Traditional overheating detection methods have shortcomings such as slow response and limited monitoring range, which cannot meet the high requirements of modern substations for safety monitoring. To address this issue, this paper proposes a substation equipment area overheating recognition technology based on infrared and visible light image fusion. This method combines infrared thermal imaging and visible light imaging, using infrared images to capture device temperature distribution information, supplemented by visible light images of device appearance features, to comprehensively improve the recognition accuracy of overheated areas. Specifically, this article proposes a fault equipment image segmentation method based on mapping the centroid of the heating area to visible light images. By accurately matching the position of the heat source with the visible light image, the localization and segmentation process of the overheated area is optimized. At the same time, image preprocessing techniques including noise removal and contrast enhancement were studied for infrared thermal images of transformers, significantly improving image quality and analysis accuracy. The experimental results show that the overheating recognition technology based on image fusion has high accuracy and real-time performance, which can effectively improve the reliability of substation equipment monitoring and provide strong support for early warning and fault diagnosis of equipment overheating problems.

articleTitle: Research on Object Detection of Suspension Clamps Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of UAV aerial images, the complex background of dangling wire clip detection can easily cause false detection and missed detection, this paper proposes a new UAV-based dangling wire clip charged detection model-YOLOV8_SL. Backbone's SPPF module is optimised to be SPPF-LSKA, which enhances the network generalisation ability and improves the model's feature extraction ability. Compared with the benchmark model, although the number of parameters of the model and the resources required for its computation are slightly increased, the mAP50 is improved by 2.5 percentage points on the dangling wire clip dataset, and the FPS is 176 for many practical application scenarios, which is able to satisfy certain real-time requirements, and at the same time, there is a better improvement on the problems of false detection and missed detection.

articleTitle: A Trusted Measurement Model of AI Algorithm for Power Grid Scheduling in Predictive Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the power grid and the rapid development of renewable energy, power grid dispatching is facing increasingly complex challenges. To improve the efficiency and reliability of grid dispatching, AI technology has been widely applied to load forecasting and optimized scheduling. However, the application of AI algorithms in grid dispatching also brings new issues, especially regarding the trustworthiness of these algorithms. If the predictions made by AI algorithms are not accurate enough or errors occur under certain conditions, it will directly affect the safety and stability of the grid. Therefore, establishing a model that can effectively evaluate the trustworthiness of AI algorithms in grid dispatching is crucial. This paper utilizes fuzzy theory to construct a trustworthiness evaluation model for predictive AI algorithms, which can calculate the overall trustworthiness of the algorithm, ensuring that its application in grid dispatching maintains a high level of trustworthiness and reliability.

articleTitle: Optimization of Sensor Health Monitoring Algorithm Based on MAX30102
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In order to meet people's needs for multifunctional and portable medical electronic devices at home, this paper proposes an algorithm for measuring multiple vital signs based on a single MAX30102 sensor. The MAX30102 photoelectric reflective sensor integrates photoelectric transmission and reception, digital-to-analog conversion, and data filtering, and has good anti-interference ability, system operation speed, and signal processing capabilities. This paper uses regression analysis technology to process temperature signals and effectively eliminates the error between body surface temperature and core temperature. The heart rate information is accurately extracted from the PPG signal by utilizing the pulse waveform data obtained by differential operation processing. In order to improve the accuracy of detection, the Dtrend detrending algorithm is selected to filter out baseline drift and motion artifact interference from the original signal to ensure the accuracy and stability of health vital sign data. The final experiment proves that the system has the characteristics of real-time, precision, and stability, which can meet the needs of real-time monitoring and has certain application value.

articleTitle: A Composite Controller for the Intelligent Rail Bulk Cargo Unloading Device
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To address the precise position control and vibration suppression requirements of the intelligent rail bulk cargo unloading device under various application scenarios and multiple disturbances, this paper proposes a composite controller based on Non-Singular Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control (NFTSMC) and Linear Extended State Observer (LESO) compensation. The device aims to achieve smooth unloading of bulk cargo across diverse scenarios, including low cargo positions, flat cargo positions, and network configurations (full network, half network, and no network), while enabling material handling and transfer during unloading. To handle the uncertainties and complex disturbances introduced by these functional goals, an NFTSMC is designed to ensure fast and accurate tracking of target positions, while the LESO dynamically compensates for unknown disturbances in the system, effectively mitigating the chattering issue of sliding mode control. Simulation results demonstrate that this composite control strategy achieves stable operation of the unloading device under multi-disturbance conditions, significantly enhancing position control accuracy and vibration suppression, thus meeting the complex functional requirements of bulk cargo unloading.

Author Keywords: Non-Singular Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control (NFTSMC)

articleTitle: Design and Finite Element Analysis of a 4MW Pumped Storage Doubly-Fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This article primarily focuses on the electromagnetic design and finite element analysis of a 4MW doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based on its rated parameters and relevant performance indicators. Firstly, utilizing the rated parameters, design principles, and relevant experience of the DFIG, the dimensions, number of pole pairs, slot count for both stator and rotor, as well as the selection of slot shapes for the DFIG are determined. Subsequently, the calculated parameters are input into the ANSYS/RMxprt module to conduct electromagnetic calculations for the motor, with adjustments made to any unreasonable parameters. Finally, to further analyze the performance of the DFIG, the ANSYS Maxwell 2D module is utilized to perform finite element analysis on the motor under no-load and load conditions, further confirming the rationality of the motor design.

articleTitle: Hybrid FM-GCN-Attention Model for Personalized Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Personalized recommendation systems play a crucial role in enhancing user engagement and decision-making across various domains. Traditional approaches, such as collaborative filtering and matrix factorization, have shown effectiveness but suffer from data sparsity and cold-start problems. Recent advances in deep learning, graph-based models, and attention mechanisms have significantly improved recommendation performance. This paper proposes a novel hybrid recommendation model that integrates Factorization Machines (FM), Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN), and Multi-Layer Attention Networks (MLAN) to optimize feature representations and enhance prediction accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed approach over baseline methods in key performance metrics.

articleTitle: Componentization of Thermo-Fluid Coupling Simulation Based on LBM
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The solution of the collision-propagation equation plays an important role in the thermal-fluid multi-physics coupling simulation. Through the collision-propagation operation of different physical quantities, LBM can integrate physical fields such as fluid and thermal into the same framework to achieve coupling solution. In this paper, the collision-propagation equation is realized through LBM, and the simulation process is further componentized to improve the efficiency and reusability of the simulation. The specific component library includes: the main control module, geometric modeling of simulation field, simulation parameter setting, simulation computing, and visualization component. In LBM, since the particle motion on each lattice is independent, the componentized approach makes it easier to assign simulation tasks to multiple processors or compute nodes, thereby increasing computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Diff-OD: Object Detection with Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Diffusion models have recently made revolutionary breakthroughs in the task of generating images from text, which has aroused many works in transferring implicit knowledge in diffusion models to visual tasks. Although these studies have found that the visual representations of the intermediate layers of diffusion models are distinguishable, they mainly focus on tasks such as semantic segmentation and depth estimation, and have not yet explored the basic visual task of object detection. Inspired by the above findings, we set out to explore the application prospects of diffusion models in visual feature object detection tasks. We found that the visual features of diffusion models are both semantic and positional, achieving excellent visual recognition results in object detection tasks. Inspired by this, we designed scene text prompts to introduce more semantic information to the diffusion model to further enhance its detection ability. Since there is a strong positional connection between the conditional text prompt and the feature map in the pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model, we concatenate the cross-attention maps with diffusion features to further enhance its representation ability. Our method surpasses the methods based on ResnetlOl and Clip as feature extractors, and achieves comparable performance with Convnext, which is currently the most advanced visual backbone.

articleTitle: Lithium-Ion Battery Model Analysis Based on Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As the application of lithium-ion batteries becomes more widespread, precise estimation of battery state becomes increasingly important. In many energy storage fields, batteries play an important role, and SOC has a significant impact on the battery management system (BMS). In this paper, a model analysis method of lithium-ion battery based on Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm (LMA) is proposed. This method only needs to obtain the voltage and current data of the battery under different working conditions, and then the parameters can be quickly identified and analyzed through the equivalent circuit model, thus improving the computational efficiency. The study is divided into two main stages: the first is to optimize the model parameters using the LMA algorithm, and the second is to verify whether SOC has improved the accuracy through experimental data. In this study, lithium-ion batteries are used as experimental materials. The results show that the proposed LMA identification framework not only has good robustness but also highly matches the experimental data. This algorithm is very effective in improving accuracy and provides great help for the future development of lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: The Design of a Miniaturized Dual-frequency Monopole Antenna Applied to the Electricity Meter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Artificially creating a high-frequency and high-voltage interference source to disrupt the normal operation of the electricity meter. When the interference is removed, the smart electricity meter can resume normal metering. This kind of electricity theft behavior is very concealed. Therefore, it is necessary to install a circuit for monitoring the disturbance of the meter, and designing a receiving antenna for the meter facing the radio frequency interference source is the basis. A miniaturized, simple-structured dual-frequency monopole antenna is proposed. Two inverted L-shaped structures are adopted, and microstrip line feeding is used to realize the design of the dual-frequency monopole antenna. The center frequencies are 2.14 GHz and 5.43 GHz respectively, and the thickness of the dielectric layer is 1.52 mm. The simulation results show that the antenna has good working characteristics in the two frequency bands, obtaining impedance bandwidths of 90 MHz and 280 MHz respectively. The antenna has a simple structure, and the overall size is only 40 mm × 40 mm × 1.52 mm, meeting the miniaturization requirements of the antenna.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation Method of Communication Network Applicable to New Distribution System Under Extreme Disasters
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The communication network of the new Distribution System with the characteristics of “double-high” integrates a large number of heterogeneous communication technologies. Its anti-destruction characteristics for extreme disasters are different from those of the ring-shaped optical fiber network. Most of the traditional network reliability evaluation methods are used to evaluate the power optical fiber backbone network and are difficult to be directly applied to the new Distribution System. This paper proposes a reliability evaluation method of the communication network applicable to the new Distribution System under extreme disasters. Firstly, considering the correlation characteristics of the power grid and the communication network, a dual-network coupling model adapted to lO-kv lines is constructed to provide a basis for subsequent analysis. Secondly, based on the historical data, the wind speed probability distribution function of the power grid nodes under typhoon disasters is generated, and at the same time, the anti-destruction models of the power grid nodes and the communication nodes are constructed. Finally, according to the cascading failure mechanism, the disaster impact process is analyzed to achieve an objective evaluation of the reliability of the communication network of the distribution system under extreme disasters, hoping to provide scientific guidance for the construction of subsequent disaster-tolerance planning schemes.

articleTitle: Low-frequency Stability Analysis of Grid-Forming DFIG
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The grid-forming DFIG has the function of self-synchronization and active support of the power grid. In recent years, it has been favored by scholars at home and abroad. However, with the gradual deepening of research, the problem of grid-forming DFIG participating in inter-system oscillation has gradually become prominent. In this paper, firstly, a grid-forming DFIG under virtual synchronous control strategy is built. Secondly, a mathematical model is established. From the perspective of electrical damping, the transfer function is used to analyze the low-frequency oscillation characteristics and instability mechanism, and the correctness of the oscillation mechanism is verified by simulation. According to the analysis and simulation results, the low frequency oscillation stability of the model is poor and prone to instability under strong power grid. In this paper, an improvement measure for a virtual synchronous control link is proposed. The control branch is added to the link to increase the system damping, so that the system has good low-frequency stability under strong and weak power grids.

articleTitle: Active Rotor Vibration Control of Rotating Machinery when Passing Through a Critical Speed
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: An active rotor vibration control method for rotating machinery integrated with an electromagnetic actuator smoothly passing through a critical speed based on online stiffness scheduling is proposed. The specific principle involves intervening in the real-time mode of the rotor system by altering the polarity of the equivalent stiffness output by the electromagnetic actuator during the run-up and run-down, ultimately achieving the effect of consistently shifting the real-time mode away from the rotor frequency. The scheduling of equivalent stiffness is determined through a sine sweeping test of the rotor system using the electromagnetic actuator. Verification was conducted based on a simulation model, and sine sweeping tests and stiffness scheduling experiments were carried out on an industrial-grade centrifugal compressor. Ultimately, the avoidance of real-time critical resonance of the rotor was achieved, enabling the centrifugal compressor to smoothly pass through the critical speed.

articleTitle: Wideband Transformer Model Based on Combined Fitting Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper addresses the transformer modeling problem by proposing a new method for establishing a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\pi}$</tex> -type equivalent circuit of transformers and developing a wideband <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\pi}$</tex> - type equivalent circuit. The proposed method combines the Matrix Pencil Method (MPM) and Vector Fitting (VF) technique, enabling automatic order determination while maintaining the high-accuracy characteristics of the VF technique. Specifically, the method involves using the MPM method to determine the order and calculate the initial poles, followed by applying the VF technique to compute the corresponding parameters for fitting. A wideband nonlinear transformer equivalent circuit model considering the ferromagnetic and frequency-dependent characteristics of transformers was established. Simulations validated the model's accuracy, showing that the proposed method outperforms the individual application of the MPM and VF techniques.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Perception Visualization of Concrete Vibrating Based on Ultrasonic Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The propagation of ultrasonic waves in concrete provides valuable insights into the material's internal properties, enabling the intelligent monitoring and evaluation of the vibration process. This study focuses on the development and application of ultrasonic technology to achieve intelligent perception and visualization during concrete vibration. Based on the elastic wave theory, the effects of material properties such as density, elastic modulus, and composition on wave propagation were analyzed. A systematic experimental investigation was conducted using concrete mixtures with varying aggregate contents to explore the relationship between ultrasonic wave characteristics and material heterogeneity. Results showed that as aggregate content increased, the wave velocity decreased, while attenuation and scattering effects became more pronounced, reflecting the growing complexity of the internal structure. This research establishes a strong theoretical and experimental foundation for optimizing the concrete vibration process and highlights the potential of ultrasonic technology for real-time quality monitoring and intelligent control in concrete construction. The findings offer practical significance for improving compactness and uniformity, thereby enhancing the overall quality of construction.

articleTitle: Research on Model Matching and Anomaly Detection Method of Distribution Network Equipment Based on OCR and Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The acceptance work of distribution network engineering lines is an important link to ensure the quality of distribution network engineering lines and effectively improve the safe and stable operation level of the distribution network. However, traditional on-site verification methods for distribution network engineering suffer from time-consuming, labor-intensive, and error prone issues, making it difficult to efficiently identify potential hazards such as construction process defects and equipment model mismatches, which pose a threat to the safe operation of the distribution network. Therefore, this article proposes a model matching and anomaly detection method for distribution network equipment based on OCR and image recognition technology. Firstly, key text information on equipment nameplates and identification plates is automatically extracted through OCR technology; Secondly, by combining image recognition models to analyze the appearance characteristics of the equipment, precise matching and anomaly detection of the equipment model can be achieved. This method integrates image processing, deep learning, and database matching techniques, which can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of line engineering quality acceptance. The experimental results show that this method has good robustness and practicality in various complex scenarios, providing important technical support for the intelligent acceptance and management of distribution network engineering.

articleTitle: Thermal Performance Analysis of 1000MW Secondary Reheating EC-BEST Unit Under Variable Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The study was conducted on the operational characteristics and thermal economy of the EC-BEST system for conventional 1000MW ultra supercritical secondary reheating units, addressing issues such as high extraction superheat and significant irreversible heat transfer losses in the reheating system. Under the same boundary conditions, EBSILON software is used to model and simulate the thermal performance changes of the 1000MW secondary reheating unit after adopting the EC-BEST system, including extraction superheat, feedwater temperature, power output and efficiency of each cylinder block, and heat consumption rate. The reasons for the thermal performance changes are briefly analyzed. The results show that the 1000MW secondary reheating unit using EC-BEST system can effectively solve the problems of high steam extraction superheat in existing conventional secondary reheating units, improve the heat exchange efficiency of the entire feedwater system and deaerator, and enhance the unit's cycle efficiency. Under THA working conditions, the degree of superheat of the No.2 to No.6 stage extraction steam is reduced from above 250°C to below 100°C, and the inlet steam of the deaerator is reduced from superheated steam to wet steam, the temperature of the feedwater increases by 3.1°C; The cycle efficiency of the unit increases, and the heat consumption rate of the unit decreases by about 23kJ/kg, equivalent to a coal consumption of about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{0.83g}/(\mathbf{kW}\cdot \mathbf{h})$</tex> for the unit.

articleTitle: Advanced Signal Processing and Machine Learning for Water Pump Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This study explores advanced vibration signal analysis of water pumps under varying conditions, using an experimental platform and ADXL345 sensor for data collection and preprocessing. Frequency and time-domain features were subsequently extracted to enhance diagnostic accuracy. Frequency-domain features, including those derived from Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and Power Spectral Density (PSD), were analyzed to identify high-contribution components. Simultaneously, time-domain features were refined using Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), selecting characteristics from specific Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs) tailored to different diagnostic requirements. The integration of time and frequency-domain features demonstrated superior discriminatory power compared to single-domain features. These advanced signal processing techniques, combined with Support Vector Machine (SVM) classification, significantly improved fault diagnosis accuracy and underscored the importance of feature fusion for robust water pump monitoring.

articleTitle: Conflict-Based Search for Multi-Robot Path Planning Using Optimal Motion Primitives
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This work presents a two-level path planning approach for multi-robot systems considering kinematic constraints. Classical search-based methods for multi-robot path planning simplify robot models, making it difficult to directly apply the obtained paths. To tackle this problem, we combine the enhanced conflict-based search (E-CBS) with the optimal motion primitive (OMP). Firstly, a series of motion primitives containing multiple waypoints are generated using nonlinear programming (NLP) offline. Then the high-level planner conducts focal conflict search over OMPs. To further accelerate the solving process, a conflict merging strategy is conducted. The low-level planner adopts a focal spatiotemporal A* algorithm with OMPs to generate a collision-free path with consideration of high-level constraints. Finally, we implement simulations to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The simulation results show that techniques used in our approach can effectively improve the efficiency of path planning.

articleTitle: An Impulse Resistance Current Control Method Suitable for Mobile Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The mobile energy storage system has the advantages of environmental friendliness, high power supply quality and two-way interaction with the power grid, and is widely used in application scenarios such as power protection for important loads and temporary power supply. However, compared with the traditional diesel-generating unit, the mobile energy storage system outputs through the power electronic interface, and its overload capacity is limited, and when there are impact loads such as motors and transformers with short-term high-rate current characteristics in the load, it may lead to the collapse of the entire off-grid power supply system. At present, in order to meet the power demand of impact loads, it is often used to increase the capacity of power electronic equipment or to adopt the current inner loop output current limiting mode in the control strategy, but the first mode increases the cost of the mobile energy storage system, and the second mode needs to be targeted with load starting, which has a narrow adaptation range, and it is easy to cause system oscillation in the process of load switching. In this paper, an anti-impulse load control algorithm suitable for mobile energy storage system is proposed, which can automatically correct the voltage control instructions and voltage control parameters according to the magnitude of the load current, effectively suppress the impulse current in the process of impulse load switching, and automatically restore the output voltage after the current stabilizes. This control method can further improve the load capacity of the off-grid power supply system and ensure the stable operation of the off-grid system without increasing the hardware cost of the equipment.

articleTitle: Research on the Simulation Analysis Method for the External Discharge Path of Flammable Liquids in Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The leakage of flammable liquid in aircraft will cause hidden dangers to flight safety. Reasonable external drainage design is very important for flight safety. According to the requirements of airworthiness regulations, where flammable liquid or vapor may escape due to leakage of liquid system, its position and scope must be determined. This paper takes a large propeller aircraft as an example, combined with CFD numerical simulation, introduces in detail the analysis method of the external liquid discharge path of aircraft, and puts forward optimization measures for the outlet of the external liquid discharge that may flow into the inlet/exhaust port and other risk areas, which can provide important guidance for the external liquid discharge path analysis of transport aircraft and the whole aircraft fire airworthiness verification.

Author Keywords: external drainage path of flammable liquid

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Analysis of Partial Discharge Fault of 500kv Transformer
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In this paper, a typical partial discharge failure of the 500kV transformer in the handover test stage is introduced. According to the local discharge signal characteristics under different pressure modes after fully eliminating external interference, it is preliminarily determined that local discharge has nothing to do with the insulation of the winding end of high and low voltage sides. Combined with the diagnostic test results after returning to the factory and the characteristics of no abnormal oil samples taken for many times, it is speculated that the fault point is not located in the winding, and there may be air gap discharge in the insulating parts. The results of disassembly inspection verify the inferences of local placement, confirm that local closed cavity of corrugated board between high and high voltage side windings leads to low energy discharge, and finally put forward suggestions to prevent similar defects of main transformer.

articleTitle: Graph Convolutional Sentiment Analysis Model Integrating Knowledge and Position Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rise of 5G and massive unstructured text data on e-commerce and social platforms has fueled interest in text sentiment analysis, especially for mining user opinions on products, social issues, and politics. Current research, primarily focused on dependency trees for aspect-level analysis, faces challenges like insufficient syntactic information extraction and limited use of external sentiment knowledge. To address the above issues, this paper proposes a model: Knowledge and Location-enhanced Graph Convolutional Network (KE-LocGCN). The model is divided into a semantic information extraction module and a syntactic information extraction module. In the syntactic information extraction part, we count the parts of speech of the dataset, construct the part-of-speech (POS) matrix and the sentiment score matrix, and obtain a feature vector containing rich syntactic information; in the semantic information extraction module, the BERT model is used to encode text words and aspect words, and the GRU-CNN network is combined to extract text semantic features. Finally, a feature fusion module based on the attention mechanism is constructed to perform feature fusion and enhance the ability of feature vector representation.

articleTitle: An Energy Minimization Scheme for NOMA-MEC
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Non-Orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-assisted mobile edge computing (MEC) has been widely studied due to its efficient utilization of communication resources. Existing works have demonstrated that the MEC system has the potential to provide higher quality of service (QoS) with lower cost by using NOMA transmission, but the impact of successive interference cancellation (SIC) decoding order in NOMA-MEC system has not been fully explored. This paper proposes an optimizing solution for power distribution and SIC decoding order in NOMA-MEC systems. And we prove that the energy consumption is minimized by using the proposed scheme. Our work explores the relationship between the SIC decoding order and power distribution in NOMA-MEC system, which are constrained by tasks and deadline. Computational experiments are conducted to explore the performance of the proposed solution. The results show the advantages of proposed solution and demonstrate that the importance of SIC decoding order becomes greater with increasing variance of channels and number of users.

articleTitle: A Multi-Dimensional View of The Differences in Accounting for Emission Factors in The Chinese Power Grid-Based on Spatio-Temporal and Emission Boundary Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Electricity CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission factor is a key parameter connecting electricity consumption and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission, which is crucial for carbon market quota allocation and assessment of carbon footprint of internationally traded products. Differences in its value can significantly affect the total carbon emissions of a company or a product. This study deeply analyses the impact of spatial and temporal characteristics and the definition of greenhouse gas emission scope on the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission factor of electricity production, and conducts an empirical study based on the data of China's electric power industry. By constructing multiple scenario assumptions, it systematically explores the impact of each key dimension on the calculation results of emission factors, and finds that different choices can lead to fluctuations of 3%, 20%-21%, and 41.52% in the calculation results of power grid emission factors, which emphasises the importance of these factors in accurate assessment. Based on this, this paper puts forward optimisation suggestions from the dimensions of accounting cycle, accounting scope and accounting boundary, aiming to provide scientific references for accurate accounting and transparent reporting of Scope 2 GHG emissions, and to promote the optimisation and development of related practices.

articleTitle: Research on the Cost-Benefit Analysis Method for Joint Operation of Distribution Network Edge Resources Based on Multi-Energy Complementarity
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As the environmental pollution problem caused by the large consumption of coal during the winter heating season becomes more and more serious, the government has adjusted the energy structure through measures such as “coal-to-gas”, but also at great cost. At the same time, some wind power resource-rich areas are facing the problem of wind abandonment in winter. This paper proposes a joint operation method based on multi-energy complementary distribution network side resources, which utilizes wind power resources and electric boilers to solve the winter heating demand, aiming to improve wind power consumption capacity and reduce environmental pollution. In the technical aspect, the impact of wind power access on grid operation is studied through simulation calculation of the actual grid frame to demonstrate the feasibility of this paper's method; in the economic aspect, the initial investment cost, operation cost and economic benefits of this heating method are calculated and analyzed in detail and in comparison. The results show that based on multi-energy complementary distribution network edge resource heating method has the advantages of low initial investment cost, stable operation, small maintenance, safety and no pollution, etc., and can effectively improve the wind power consumption capacity, reduce the problem of wind abandonment, and has a strong economy and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Bidding Strategy of Electric Vehicle Aggregators in Power Markets Considering Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rapid growth of electric vehicle (EV) numbers and their deep integration with smart grids, the role of Electric Vehicle Aggregators (EVA) in power markets is becoming increasingly important. This paper proposes a stochastic-robust joint optimization bidding decision model considering uncertainties. The model generates representative random electricity price scenarios using the K-means clustering method, applies robust control coefficients to handle the randomness of EV charging and discharging behaviors, and uses willingness-to-respond coefficients to simulate the uncertainties of EV responses. By solving the model, the proposed approach is validated, demonstrating good effectiveness and robustness under various scenarios and significantly enhancing the EVA ability to maximize profits in the power market.

articleTitle: Design of a Vehicle Personnel Stay Prevention and Early Warning System Based on Wireless Local Area Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The conventional anti detention early warning system mainly focuses on the optimization of early warning threshold, which increases the difficulty of data processing and decreases the system performance. Therefore, an intelligent early warning system based on wireless local area network is designed. In terms of hardware, STM32L051C8T6 microcontroller and MPU6050 gyroscope are designed. In terms of software, an early warning framework for intelligent vehicle personnel to prevent detention is established, and the interaction mode and data transmission mechanism between various modules are clarified to ensure that the system can efficiently and accurately realize the early warning function for preventing detention. Based on the wireless local area network (WLAN), the intelligent vehicle personnel anti detention early warning algorithm is designed to make full use of WLAN technology and avoid potential safety hazards by setting reasonable early warning threshold and trigger conditions. Update the data receiving and sending thread of intelligent on-board personnel detention early warning, obtain the latest information of personnel activities in the vehicle in real time, and dynamically adjust and optimize the early warning algorithm to ensure that the system maintains a stable operating state in a complex and changing environment. The system test proves that the system has higher performance and can be applied in real life.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect of Space Radiated Electromagnetic Interference Generated by AC Filter Busbar VFTO on Secondary System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In recent years, with the implementation of the “Dual-Carbon Strategy”, the construction scale of new energy stations has gradually increased. AC filters in new energy stations can eliminate the large amount of harmonics generated by power electronic switching devices and compensate for the large amount of reactive power consumed by them. However, the switching operation of AC filters enclosed in the GIS structure generates severe VFTO and is accompanied by strong electromagnetic interference. Current research indicates that the EMI generated by the AC filter GIS busbar charging operation is sufficient to affect the normal operation of the secondary system that monitors the operating status of the synchronous compensator. In this paper, we take the disturbed secondary equipment in the plant of synchronous compensator as the research object, and analyze the influence of spatial electromagnetic interference on it through the electromagnetic field distribution in its vicinity. In this paper, firstly, the calculation model of AC filter GIS busbar VFTO is established, and the busbar overvoltage under different closing angles and load-side residual voltages is calculated, and then the electromagnetic field around the AC filter and synchronous compensator plant is calculated under the condition of maximum overvoltage, and the degree of interference of the secondary equipment is analyzed. The results of the study show that the electromagnetic field strength of space radiation generated by the AC filter GIS busbar opening and closing is less than the standard requirements for secondary equipment to withstand electro-magnetic field, so the electromagnetic interference is not coupled to the secondary equipment of the synchronous compensator plant through space radiation.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Power Plant Resource Aggregation Considering Fast and Slow Charging of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of electric vehicles (EV s)., effectively integrating resources in virtual power plants (VPPs) under different charging modes to enhance grid stability and economic benefits has become a research focus. Considering the distribution characteristics., operational attributes., and adjustable features of EV s under fast-charging and slow-charging modes., the overall daily load curve of EV s can be derived for various charging scenarios. By determining the controllable capacity of EV s and the corresponding V2G (Vehicle-to-Grid) and G2V (Grid-to-Vehicle) power., and verifying the tracking performance of EV s to grid load signals through capacity regulation evaluation (CRE) coefficients., it becomes possible to design optimized charging and discharging scheduling strategies. This approach improves the efficiency and economic performance of coordinated EV and grid operation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Grounding Fault of Overhead Broken Line in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In the medium and low power distribution system of 6-66kV, the single-phase broken line grounding fault of overhead line often occurs, which endangers personal safety and affects the normal operation of power load. Under the premise of considering the nature of the load on the grounding point, the current and voltage of the protection installation point, the broken point, the grounding point and the load side when the single-phase broken line grounding fault in power distribution system with neutral non-effectively grounded are analyzed, and the calculation formula of the voltage and current at each point is derived. The analysis results shows that the voltage of protection installation, grounding point and load side is related to load properties and transition resistance. The voltage at the broken point is related to the load properties. In this paper, a real distribution network grounding fault is analyzed, focusing on the grounding protection action and fault disposal.

Author Keywords: Single-phase-to-ground fault in power distribution system with neutral non-effectively grounded

articleTitle: Comparison Study of Carbon Footprint of Different Transformer Models in Low-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Approximately 40% of global carbon dioxide emissions originate from the power sector. In addition to emissions generated during electricity production, various electrical facilities, including transformers, contribute approximately 4% to these emissions due to losses. This paper presents a lifecycle-based carbon footprint evaluation process and assessment model, focusing on three common transformer models used in the distribution network. The model effectively calculates the carbon emissions associated with different lifecycle stages of various capacities and types of 10 kV oil-immersed transformers. The halflife cycle assessment reveals the carbon footprint composition of different transformer types and illustrates how the carbon emissions of each component vary with transformer capacity. In contrast, the full lifecycle analysis shows that carbon emissions during the transformer's operational phase account for the majority of total emissions. This study concludes that replacing low-loss transformers and enhancing the overall efficiency of the distribution network are crucial for reducing carbon emissions

articleTitle: Research on Online Identification Method of Foreign Object Invasion in Transmission Lines Based on Image Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a wire foreign object alarm method for online monitoring of transmission lines to address the issues of low accuracy in monitoring floating objects invading transmission lines and insufficient effectiveness of alarms. This method first constructs an intelligent detection model for floating objects based on a multi-scale RPN network, which realizes the recognition of small-sized hidden danger targets in monitoring scenarios. Subsequently, the article used the improved canny algorithm to extract wires from the images and constructed an effective area for wire foreign object alarm, which was used to remove invalid floating object recognition results such as the ground. Finally, this article conducted tests on the dataset, and the results showed that the proposed method achieved a 97.7% recall rate for wire foreign object alarms, and could greatly reduce false alarms, meeting the needs of intelligent monitoring of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Variable Weight Quality Evaluation of Oil Immersed Transformers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The author discusses and analyzes a quality assessment method specifically for oil immersed transformers in this article. The method used is actually based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process with comprehensive variable weights, as well as the quality assessment method for oil immersed transformers involving correlation coefficients. We conducted experiments on oil immersed transformers using Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHnducted quantitative and qualitative analysis on the data collected after the eP) and inverse entropy weight method, and coxperiment and the detection results in actual work. We combined the correlation coefficients of the instruments and equipment to derive various evaluation indicators for oil immersed transformers, sorted them according to their importance, and found their internal important relationships. Finally, based on fuzzy evaluation, we proposed a quality evaluation method for oil immersed transformers based on comprehensive variable weight. This method is very feasible and can effectively reflect the interrelationships between various indicators in oil immersed transformers and distinguish which ones are important. In practical work, it can be applied to the quality evaluation of oil immersed distribution transformers to improve work efficiency.

articleTitle: Differential-Based Non-Contact Optical Sensor for Transient Signal Measurement Method and System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The paper proposes a non-contact measurement method and system for railway transportation based on optical sensors, aiming to address the issues associated with traditional track measurement methods, such as equipment wear, high operational difficulty, and impacts on the track system caused by contact-based measurements. The paper first analyzes the requirements and challenges of railway transportation measurement, introduces the working principle and advantages of non-contact optical sensors, and designs a non-contact measurement system tailored to the specific needs of railway transportation. The system uses high-precision optical sensors to capture geometric parameters of the track in real-time, such as track gauge, track height, and track smoothness, while avoiding physical contact with the track. Experimental validation of the system demonstrates the feasibility and superiority of the method in railway transportation measurements, as it not only improves measurement accuracy but also effectively reduces interference and human error during the measurement process. Finally, the paper looks ahead to the future applications and development directions of this measurement method, proposing further improvements to the system's stability and adaptability to meet the growing measurement demands of railway transportation.

articleTitle: Applying Text and Image Mining Techniques for Identifying Future Signals of AI-Powered Products
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Since the debut of Sora earlier this year, AI products have rapidly integrated into everyday life, with Apple's launch of the Apple Intelligence AI phone being a prime example. Exploring the impact of AI on smart products helps accelerate their integration, offering smarter and more convenient services. This study proposes a multimodal approach to detect future signals of AI-powered products, utilizing the extended BERTopic model to integrate text and image data, and employing theme filtering and meaning construction methods to extract and expand weak signals. By collecting a multimodal dataset from Sina News and validating it with the Apple AI phone case, the study demonstrates the effectiveness of future signals, providing valuable guidance for the development of AI-powered products and expanding the application of future signals in multimodal data analysis.

articleTitle: Electro Magnetic Compatibility Analysis of Signal Interference on Ultra-Low Power Four-Level ECT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To enhance the electromagnetic protection performance of ultra-low power Electronic Current Transformer (ECT), a damping oscillatory wave (DOW) disturbance test is conducted on it. A method for generating parallel resonant DOWs is proposed, which involves two-stage following and amplification of the initial waveform, enabling a maximum voltage of over 12V. Finally, considering the characteristics of the output signal from the four-level encoding module of ultra-low power ECT, electromagnetic interference countermeasures combining Transient Voltage Suppressor diodes with RC low-pass filters are proposed. Experimental results show that the four-level encoding module is extremely sensitive to voltage fluctuations due to the nonlinear relationship between the voltage and current of the LED. The normal operation of the four-level encoding module can be ensured through anti-interference measures.

articleTitle: Research on Large Signal Stabilization Control of Energy Storage Grid-Connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The constant power energy storage grid-connected inverters have typical nonlinear characteristics, and the micro-grid system based on energy storage inverters is difficult to run smoothly when subjected to large disturbances. Therefore, to ensure that the system can return to stable operation after large disturbance, it is necessary to analyze the large signal stability of the energy storage grid-connected inverter.
