In this paper, a nonlinear stability analysis method is proposed by using mixed potential function theory, and a stabilization control strategy based on large signal model is proposed. The simulation model of constant power energy storage grid-connected inverter is established by using Simulink module in MATLAB, and the large signal stability region is analyzed, and the control parameters are optimized. Finally, the actual platform is built and the related experiments are carried out. The experimental results show that the dynamic performance of the system is greatly improved, and the stability of the system is enlarged, thus improving the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Improved Path Tracking Optimization Method for Intelligent Vehicles Using Standard Wide-Angle Lenses
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rapid development of autonomous driving technology, the path tracking capability of intelligent vehicles has become a focus of research. This paper addresses the issue of insufficient path tracking accuracy of intelligent vehicles using standard wide-angle CMOS cameras in complex track environments, proposing a method that combines perspective image processing and inverse perspective image processing (Combined Perspective Processing, CPR). This method first directly extracts the track edges from the original perspective image, preserving the detailed information and a wide effective field of view of the image. Then, by using inverse perspective Transformation processing, these edge coordinates are mapped to the coordinate system of the top-down view to enhance the recognition rate of track elements and the accuracy of path tracking. Experimental results show that compared to traditional methods, this method significantly improves path tracking error and element recognition accuracy, with high robustness and practical value.

Author Keywords: intelligent vehicle;inverse perspective image processing.perspective image processing;standard wide-angle

articleTitle: Research on Economic Analysis and Comprehensive Evaluation Method of Compressed Air Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This article explores the importance of energy storage technology in improving the efficiency, safety, economy, and utilization of renewable energy in the power system, in the context of global energy transition and in response to fossil fuel shortages and environmental pollution. This article focuses on analyzing the economics of compressed air energy storage (CAES) technology, evaluating the economics of CAES systems of different scales through a full life cycle assessment method, and combining economic analysis with technical and economic analysis to propose a comprehensive multi-agent evaluation method that comprehensively evaluates the feasibility of CAES projects from the perspectives of different stakeholders. The research results indicate that the technical performance of CAES systems, such as efficiency, operating life, and network related performance, is competitive, but the economy still faces challenges. This article validates the effectiveness of the evaluation method through an arithmetic case study and identifies the key factors that affect the economic viability of CAES power plants.

articleTitle: Operational Optimization Strategy for Virtual Power Plants Considering Carbon Trading and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To enhance the carbon reduction capacity and economic performance of virtual power plants (VPPs), an operational optimization method incorporating various flexible loads into demand response is proposed. First, a diversified model of flexible loads within the VPP is developed by classifying them based on their distinct characteristics. Then, an improved tiered carbon trading mechanism is formulated by optimizing the traditional stepped carbon pricing model to encourage carbon reduction across the system. Subsequently, an operational optimization model is constructed with the objective of minimizing total operational costs, encompassing both system operational and carbon trading costs, and solved using the CPLEX solver. Finally, three scenarios are designed for comparative analysis to verify the model's effectiveness. Results indicate that establishing appropriate base carbon prices and interval lengths can jointly optimize low-carbon and economic performance. The improved tiered carbon trading mechanism and demand response strategies effectively reduce VPP operational costs and carbon emissions, yielding substantial economic and environmental benefits.

articleTitle: Channel State Information Prediction Using Transformer Models for High-Mobility Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Channel state information (CSI) prediction is pivotal for ensuring robust and efficient operation in high-mobility wireless networks, where rapidly changing channel conditions demand accurate and timely forecasts. This paper presents a novel non-autoregressive Transformer-based framework that predicts future downlink CSI from previous uplink measurements for frequency division duplex (FDD) systems. Unlike conventional autoregressive or recurrent approaches that predict sequentially, our method leverages a purely encoder-based Transformer to produce multi-step downlink predictions in parallel, reducing error propagation problem and latency. Experimental results show that our Transformer framework significantly lowers the mean squared error compared to benchmarks, highlighting the robustness and suitability of our model for next-generation networks in high-mobility scenarios.

articleTitle: CNN-LSTM-Based Insider Threat Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the continuous development of electrical, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) systems, ensuring the security of system data has become increasingly important. Compared to external threats, insider threats to intelligent systems present greater concealment and potential harm. In this article, an insider threat detection model based on the CNN-LSTM (Convolutional Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory) algorithm is proposed. The method first extracts key features of user behavior through the CNN layer, followed by user behavior prediction using the LSTM layer. Finally, a fully connected layer performs binary classification to identify whether the behavior constitutes a threat. The experiments are conducted using the CMU-CERT R4.2 public dataset. Results from comparative neural network experiments demonstrate that this model achieves stable accuracy and precision rates exceeding 90%, with excellent performance on the ROC curve.

Author Keywords: Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Network

articleTitle: Composite Generator for Wave Energy Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Ocean energy, including wave energy, tidal energy and ocean temperature difference energy, has great potential for development. Compared with wind and solar energy on land, ocean energy has the advantages of high energy density, strong stability and good predictability, and is a very ideal green energy. Based on the above background, this paper designs a composite Generator, which uses Triboelectric Nanogenerator (TENG) and Electromagnetic Generator (EMG). TENG is a novel technology capable of capturing mechanical energy from the environment and converting it into electricity, which is particularly suitable for harnessed common natural or man-made power sources such as human movement, wind, water flow, etc. It is based on the triboelectric effect, which is the transfer of charge when two different materials come into contact, which creates a voltage difference between them, which in turn generates an electric current. EMG is a device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy through the principle of electromagnetic induction, usually providing a stable power output, which is very important for equipment and systems that require continuous power supply.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Electrical Engineering Equipment Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy neural network (FNN) based fault diagnosis method for electrical engineering equipment is proposed. The method generates a training sample set and a test sample set by collecting the operation data of electrical equipment, and extracts and classifies the fault features using a fuzzy neural network model. The structural configuration, parameter optimization and training process of the fuzzy neural network are analyzed in detail in the study, the cross-entropy is used as the optimization objective function, and the Adam algorithm is selected for training. By analyzing the fault cases of transformers and transmission lines, the results show that the diagnostic accuracy of this method reaches 99.20% and 98.15% for fault lines and fault types, respectively. In addition, this paper also explores the effect of noise interference on the fault diagnosis effect, and the results show that the method has anti-interference ability to a certain extent. Finally, through the comparative analysis with traditional machine learning and deep learning methods, the advantages of the fuzzy neural network-based fault diagnosis method in terms of accuracy and robustness are verified, which provides reliable technical support for the safe operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Electricity Detection and Diagnosis Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The abnormal diagnosis report of electricity metering is a prerequisite for on-site inspection and a very important part of the abnormal electricity consumption diagnosis process. This article proposes a measurement anomaly detection and diagnosis algorithm for smart grids based on this requirement. Through in-depth research on the current status and demand of measurement anomaly diagnosis, based on the Faster R-CNN network structure, a model for detecting and diagnosing abnormal electricity consumption is studied. The model includes three functions: abnormal day detection, abnormal data detection, and abnormal time interval detection, thus achieving complete abnormal diagnosis and generation. Through experimental verification, the model performs well in abnormal behavior judgment and abnormal day detection models.

articleTitle: Research on Sequence Sampling Method Based on Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The cooling fan is crucial for engine heat dissipation, and the blades, as an important component of the fan, have a significant impact on its performance. This paper focuses on the blade section, namely the cascade, as the research object. To address issues related to complex modeling and low accuracy in the study, a sequence sampling method based on local complexity and sample sparsity is proposed. This approach is contrasted with conventional sampling techniques employing standard test functions. The findings demonstrate that with fewer samples, the suggested approach can create a high-precision surrogate model. Lastly, real-world engineering applications are used to verify the efficacy of this approach.

articleTitle: Risk Quantification Based Intraday Flexibility Resource Adjustment Strategy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a risk quantification based intraday scheduling theory for active distribution networks (ADNs) to solve the increasing volatility of renewable energy and the difficulties of distribution network safety. The article employs the Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) algorithm to sample the data, and the historical data is sampled to construct a full cycle probability trend sequence, in order to screen out weak nodes/branches of ADN. Thus, in the intraday stage, the safety risks experienced in each period were quantified based on predicted data, and the periods with smooth source load fluctuations and low risk probabilities were identified. The model solution step size was dynamically adjusted to shorten the calculation time. Further accelerate the online solution process of the model and adapt to the fast solution of large-scale complex risk scheduling. Finally, simulation was conducted on the IEEE33 node distribution system to obtain a flexible resource adjustment scheme.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Considering Perceived Data Quality
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In distributed photovoltaic (PV) power generation systems, data quality plays a critical role in the accuracy of predictive models. However, the complexity of distributed PV sensor data, including issues such as missing values, noise and anomalous bias, often leads to data quality degradation, which seriously affects the reliability of the prediction. To address these challenges, this study proposes a novel forecasting method that integrates sensor data quality into the forecasting process to improve the reliability and robustness of forecasts. The method starts with a detailed analysis of distributed PV sensor data characteristics to identify patterns of data quality degradation and their impact on forecast accuracy. Data recovery algorithm based on adaptive mean drift clustering with multi-paradigm optimisation is presented to effectively deal with data loss and reduce noise. In addition, an adversarial graphical neural network (GNN) is used for knowledge migration and spatio-temporal correlation modelling to make accurate predictions even in the presence of perceived data quality degradation. The GNN framework exploits spatial dependence and temporal dynamics to create robust prediction models. Simulation results show that the proposed method significantly improves the data quality and prediction accuracy of distributed PV power generation, providing a reliable basis for decision making in energy management systems.

articleTitle: A Detection Algorithm of Rail Surface Defects Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In the field of railway transportation, the integrity of the rails is a core element in ensuring the safe operation of trains. As the railway network continues to expand and the transportation load increases, the detection of surface defects on the rails becomes particularly critical. Neglecting defects such as cracks, wear, and corrosion could lead to catastrophic consequences. This study is dedicated to developing an advanced rail surface defect detection algorithm based on artificial intelligence, significantly enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of detection. We propose an innovative “Enhanced Feature Fusion U-Net” (EFF-U-Net) model, which, through its designed skip connections, achieves efficient fusion of features, thereby greatly improving the recognition ability of the model for details on the rail surface. Faced with the scarcity of rail surface defect datasets, we have employed data augmentation techniques to effectively expand the sample size and enhance the model's generalization capabilities. Through experimental validation on the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{RSDDS}+\text{dataset}$</tex>, our method has demonstrated exceptional performance, significantly improving the accuracy and identification capability of defect detection.

articleTitle: Research on a Data-Driven Safety Risk Assessment Model for Electrical Switching Operations in Substations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the continuous development and increasing complexity of power systems, the safety of switching operations in substations has become an important issue for ensuring the stable operation of the power grid. In response to this issue, this paper proposes a safety risk prediction method for electrical switching operations based on the integration of an Improved Black Kite Algorithm (IBKA) and Extreme Learning Machine (ELM). The traditional Black Kite Optimization Algorithm (BKA) tends to fall into local optima when solving high-dimensional complex problems, which affects optimization performance. To address this, several strategies have been applied to improve the BKA, leading to the development of an Improved Black Kite Algorithm. These improvements include an adaptive search strategy, enhanced local optimization, and a hybrid intelligent mechanism, all of which effectively enhance the global search capability and local convergence of the IBKA, thus improving the optimization accuracy and efficiency. Experimental results show that the safety risk prediction model based on IBKA-ELM performs excellently in predicting the risks of switching operations, achieving an accuracy of 0.926, which significantly outperforms traditional machine learning models. Compared to traditional models, the IBKA-ELM model not only achieves higher prediction accuracy but also demonstrates stronger robustness. The IBKA-ELM model proposed in this paper provides an effective solution for predicting the safety risks of electrical switching operations in power systems, enabling the early identification of potential risks and offering decision support for the safe operation and management of power systems, with broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on the Distinction Method of Partial Discharge Inside and Outside the Windings of 110 kV Transformer in Early Operation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a method to distinguish partial discharge inside and outside transformer windings using online dissolved gas analysis and acetylene concentration measurement in 110 kV oil-immersed self-cooled transformers during early operation. A finite element model of the transformer is built, and four typical locations prone to partial discharge are selected to simulate acetylene diffusion. Results show that when partial discharge occurs within windings, the time for acetylene concentration to reach the alarm value increases from top to bottom detection points. However, no clear pattern is observed for discharges outside the windings. Acetylene concentration peaks, steady-state values, and differences increase as detection points get closer.

articleTitle: A GNN Based Voltage Sensitivity Perception Method for Distribution Networks with Variable Topology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Traditional data-driven voltage sensitivity analysis methods exhibit limited adaptability in response to network topology changes, which need to retrain the neural networks according to the updated topology information. To address this issue, this paper proposes a voltage sensitivity perception method based on graph neural networks (GNN). By embedding prior topology knowledge for information propagation, the method can effectively capture the feature mapping patterns of various topologies, thereby demonstrating improved model generalization ability in unknown topology scenarios. Matlab/Simulation results show that, compared to conventional data-driven algorithms, the proposed method achieves faster and more accurate sensitivity calculations in time-varying topology scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Fault-Tolerant Dual Active Bridge Converter Based on Half-Bridge Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In this paper, based on the research background of the voltage instability phenomenon generated by the possible device failures and the serious imbalance of sunshine in the high-latitude cold region of photovoltaic power generation, a topology study of fault-tolerant dual active bridge converter based on half-bridge multiplexing is proposed, which can realize the stable output in the wide range of voltage inputs and part of the device failures, and has the effect of maintaining the stability of grid voltage and improving the power quality of DC power grid. The proposed converter can realize stable output even under a wide range of voltage inputs and some device failures to maintain the stability of grid voltage and improve the power quality of DC network. In this paper, the modal analysis of the proposed converter is carried out, and the fault conditions are analyzed, and the circuit characterization and simulation verification are completed to prove the accuracy of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Flexible Scheduling Optimization of Four-Way Shuttle Systems Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The four-way shuttle system, known for its high level of automation and strong handling capacity, is widely used in flexible automated warehousing systems. To enhance operational efficiency, this study establishes an optimization model for the scheduling of multiple four-way shuttles, targeting order completion time, minimal energy consumption, and shortest travel paths. An improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve this model, providing optimal solutions for order allocation. By testing the algorithm under different system parameters, results show that the improved genetic algorithm achieves at least a 25% improvement in optimization efficiency compared to traditional genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Permanent Magnet Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Permanent Magnet Assisted Synchronous Magnetic Reluctance Motor (PMaSynRM) exhibits lower efficiency and torque density. This paper focuses on optimizing the efficiency and average output torque of PMaSynRM, emphasizing the impact of permanent magnet quantity and end angles of the flux barrier on motor performance. The analysis determines the rotor's flux barrier shape, number of layers, and optimal flux barrier ratio of the rotor. Subsequently, the Taguchi method conducts sensitivity analysis on permanent magnet width at different positions. Combining the end angles of the flux barrier, a Kriging surrogate model of PMaSynRM is established using Latin hypercube sampling. The model's accuracy is improved through additional point selection based on the expected improvement criterion. A multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is then employed to obtain Pareto frontiers related to motor efficiency and average output torque. After optimization, while maintaining constant output torque, magnet usage is reduced by 22%, torque contribution per unit of magnet increases by 29%, and motor efficiency improves by 2.7%. Finally, based on the optimization results, a prototype is fabricated and experimentally tested, demonstrating an efficiency of 94.4% at the rated operating point and validating the accuracy of the optimized design.

Author Keywords: Permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motor

articleTitle: Transmission Line Meteorological Risk Data Automatic Generation and Auxiliary Label Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the global warming, extreme weather phenomena occur frequently, which poses a serious threat to the safe operation of transmission lines. Aiming at the problem of in-completed meteorological risk data of historical transmission lines, in this paper, we propose a method that can automatically generate time series data and assist labels. The method is based on artificial intelligence technology, and comprises feature correlation analysis, data sample generation, data sample auxiliary labeling and other modules, it realizes the accurate prediction and effective management of meteorological risk of transmission lines. This paper introduces the technical principle and implementation steps of this method in detail. It provides strong support for risk early warning and emergency response in the power industry.

articleTitle: CNC Machine Tool Operation Status Monitoring System Based on Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of difficulty in obtaining fault data for remote status monitoring and fault diagnosis of CNC machine tools, a digital-twin based method for remote status monitoring and fault data simulation of CNC machine tools is proposed. Firstly, a digital model of the CNC machine tool is constructed using 3D modeling software. Then, a digital twin model of the CNC machine tool is built in Unity3D to monitor its operating status. In addition, the constructed digital twin model of the CNC machine tool spindle was used to simulate the fault data of the machine tool spindle bearing, which will be used as training data for the diagnosis of machine tool spindle bearing faults. Finally, a machine tool operation monitoring UI interface based on digital twin was designed and developed.

articleTitle: Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm for VSG Control
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the increasing seriousness of energy problems and the extensive use of new energy sources, how to ensure that the new energy power generation system has good grid-connected stability has become a new research hotspot. Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology introduces the operating characteristics of synchronous generator (SG) on the basis of grid-connected inverter, so that it has the same rotor inertia and damping. However, the design of VSG system parameters is complicated, and the traditional whale optimization (WOA) algorithm often fails to achieve the best optimization effect. To address this problem, a mathematical model of the VSG system is established, and based on the WOA algorithm, a mixed-strategy improved whale optimization (IWOA) algorithm is proposed. By comparing the simulation results under the environment of grid voltage and frequency fluctuation, it is proved that the IWOA algorithm is more suitable for VSG grid stabilization.

articleTitle: Deep Multi-Attention Network with Earth Mover's Distance for Few-Shot fault Diagnosis of Guardrail Production Mold Platform
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The structure of the guardrail production mold platform is a typical rotor system. Rotor system fault diagnosis based on few-shot learning aims to solve the problem of sample scarcity in practical engineering. Many methods based on metric-learning perform few-shot fault classification by learning a metric function. However, they have the following problems: (1) The method of using local descriptors to perform metric-learning does not consider the impact of irrelevant regions. In their method, relevant regions and irrelevant regions have the same importance. (2) Most few-shot fault diagnosis methods pay little attention to the problem of insufficient sample extraction, resulting in the failure to maximize the use of limited fault samples. To solve the above problems, deep multi-attention network with Earth Mover's Distance (EDMN) is proposed for few-shot intelligent fault diagnosis of rotor system. This method adopts a best matching between fault samples to solve the problem of few-shot fault diagnosis. Firstly, a deep network using multi-attention mechanism is applied to extract effective fault features of rotor system. Then, Earth Mover's Distance is used as a metric to calculate the structural distance between fault features. In order to generate different weights for different local descriptors, a cross-reference method is introduced to generate weights. We carried out a number of experiments to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that our method has certain advantages over other few-shot learning fault diagnosis methods.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Partial Discharge in Dry-Type Hollow Reactor Based on UHF-Fibre Grating Combined Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Dry hollow reactors play an indispensable role in the safe and stable operation of power systems. However, its encapsulation material (epoxy resin) in the long-term use of the process of moisture and heat aging, reactor production process of wire burrs and other defects are likely to trigger the partial discharge of the reactor, which evolves into a turn-to-turn insulation failure, endangering the safe operation of the reactor. Nowadays, the detection means of reactor in the pre-turn short-circuit sensitivity is poor, and most of them can not do to identify the type of fault. Therefore, this paper proposes a combined acoustic-electrical detection method combining ultra-high frequency sensors and fibre grating sensors, which is experimentally verified in the laboratory by the encapsulation model. In the reactor turn-to-turn short-circuit fault pre-fault identification by partial discharge detection fault, for the safe operation of the reactor to provide an effective means of online detection.

articleTitle: The Impact of Different Environments on Lightning Induced Voltages of 10kV Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In order to reduce the loss caused by lightning events of 10kV overhead line, combined with the basic theory of circuit, power system analysis and electromagnetism, a lightning induction model of 10kV overhead line was established by using finite element software, and the influence of different factors on the lightning induction voltage of 10kV overhead line was studied by simulation test. The simulation results show that: With the increase of soil conductivity, the lightning induced voltage of overhead line decreases. As the height of the overhead line increases, the lightning-induced voltage also rises. The electric field intensity varies at different points on the overhead line due to lightning-induced voltage, with higher intensity and opposite polarity at both ends. It can be seen that increasing the soil conductivity and reducing the height of the overhead line can reduce the lightning induced voltage of the overhead line. The results of this simulation test have positive significance for the design and optimization of the overhead line lightning safety evaluation and optimization of the lightning protection devices of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategic Planning of New Power System Considering the Cooperative Optimization Operation of Source and Network Load and Storage Under the Dual Carbon Target
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper studies the strategic planning of the new power system under the background of dual-carbon target, with special attention to the cooperative optimization of the load and storage operation of the source network. This study simulates the development trend of China's energy and power system from 2020 to 2060 by constructing a medium - and long-term energy and power development forecast model, and analyzes the evolution trend of related core indicators. The study emphasizes the strategic importance of green electricity substitution and green hydrogen substitution in the construction of new energy systems and new power systems, and explores the key role of these alternative strategies in achieving low-carbon transition. In order to improve the flexibility and reliability of the system, this paper also studies the cooperative control methods in the new power system, including the construction of the source load and storage model, the construction of the control target model, the constraint setting and the optimization algorithm solving. Through improved genetic algorithm and ant colony algorithm, an optimized cooperative control scheme is proposed to minimize total operating cost and load fluctuation. The findings provide comprehensive analysis and strategic insights for policy development and energy system planning to support the achievement of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals

Author Keywords: Source network load and storage collaborative optimization

articleTitle: The Impact of Changes in Primary Energy Prices and Electricity Prices on the Industrial Energy Structure
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of global energy transformation, the impact of energy price fluctuations on the industrial energy structure has become an important research topic. Based on the annual data of Zhejiang Province, this paper adopts the improved NL-CES (nonlinear constant elastic substitution) model to quantitatively analyze the impact of coal, natural gas, oil and electricity price fluctuations on the industrial energy structure. By considering the substitution effect between energy sources, the model describes the industrial sector in the face of energy price changes, estimates the energy substitution elasticity coefficient through regression analysis, and applies these coefficients to predict the change in energy consumption after price changes. This paper provides a new quantitative analysis method for the impact of energy price fluctuations on the industrial energy structure, and combines actual data to demonstrate the potential impact of energy price changes. It provides an important reference for governments and enterprises in energy pricing, policy regulation and energy structure optimization.

articleTitle: An Improved Cold Startup Strategy with Bias-Flip Rectifier for Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To satisfy the demand of green philosophy of renewable energy, self-powered energy harvesting system from the piezoelectric energy have been applied as an alternative solution to battery. Unfortunately, piezoelectric energy harvesting system has several challenges at low excitation level, which requires additional auxiliary supply to accomplish the function of cold startup. This paper presents an improved cold startup strategy with bias-flip rectifier, which is designed in a 0.18 μm BCD process. As the simulation shows that not only the successful cold startup is attained when open voltage Voc is equal to 0.45V, but also the output voltage of PEH is 3 times of that in negative voltage rectifier (NVC). Compared with the full bridge rectifier (FBR), the bias-flip rectifier has a higher voltage conversion efficiency (VCE) of about 99%. The output power is about 14.4 μW, and has a better voltage flipping efficiency which is 93.5%.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Data Acquisition Technology of Dispatching Automation System Based on Container
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the acceleration of carbon emissions peak and carbon neutrality processes, the types and methods of data acquisition in dispatching automation system are showing a trend of heterogeneity and complexity, and the scale of data is growing exponentially, which also puts forward higher requirements for the technical support capabilities of power grid automation. This article proposes utilizing the virtualization characteristics of containers to uniformly allocate, schedule, and manage all server resources; Utilizing the fast deployment feature of containers to achieve rapid adaptive dynamic scaling of data acquisition tasks; Utilize the resource isolation feature of containers to improve the fault tolerance of data acquisition services; By utilizing real-time data acquisition technology based on autonomous and controllable containers, we can flexibly adapt to the large-scale access needs of diverse new application entities and enhance the basic support capabilities of the dispatching automation system.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning-Based Compression Processing Technology for UAV Inspection Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the wide application of channel visualization technology and UAV inspection in the power system, the image intelligent recognition technology has achieved initial success in the power transmission and distribution profession. However, the multiple use of channel visualization devices and UAV inspections has led to the accumulation and storage of super-large-scale datasets, and the unstructured data storage resources are becoming increasingly tight. In this paper, a deep learning-based image compression processing technique for UAV inspection is proposed to address this situation. The research includes feature extraction and analysis of UAV inspection images, compression algorithm design, and image recovery quality assessment. Through experimental verification, the technique can significantly reduce storage requirements while maintaining high image recovery quality, providing a feasible solution for the efficient management of large-scale image data in power systems. This research has important practical significance, which can reduce the storage pressure of unstructured platform and improve the practical level of the system.

articleTitle: A Line Fault Detection Method Based on Feature-Driven Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the expansion of the scale and complexity of the active distribution network, the risk of fault is also rising significantly. The line fault detection has become a key to ensure the safe and stable operation of the system. The existing researches do not fully consider the impact of unmeasured branches, and the fault feature mining is insufficient. For improvement, this paper proposes a new fault detection method based on feature-driven extreme learning machine (ELM). This method collects voltage and current signals, and deeply excavates four key characteristic parameters: differential modulus feature, current change modulus feature, voltage modulus feature and voltage and current phase difference feature. Then, by analyzing the line fault feature data, a feature-driven ELM model was constructed, so as to significantly improve the accuracy of fault detection and effectively deal with undetectable branches. The simulation test results show that the ELM model trained by fault features can accurately detect faults of lines with undetectable branches. The proposed method is expected to provide a more solid guarantee for the safe and stable operation of active distribution network.

articleTitle: Predicting Grounding Resistance of Transmission Towers for Enhanced Lightning Protection Using Temporal Fusion Transformer
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of power grids is essential to meet the growing demand for electricity in modern society. Transmission lines, crucial to the power system, are particularly vulnerable to damage from lightning strikes, which account for a significant portion of power grid failures, especially in mountainous regions with complex terrain. Grounding resistance plays a vital role in lightning protection, with its performance being influenced by various environmental and operational factors. This paper proposes a novel approach for predicting the grounding resistance of transmission towers using the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) model. TFT, an advanced attention-based deep learning model, is employed to forecast grounding resistance values by leveraging temporal and environmental data. By integrating static covariates, observed inputs, and known future inputs, the TFT model captures both short-term and long-term dependencies, enabling accurate predictions of grounding resistance across different scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate the potential of the TFT model to enhance the reliability of lightning protection systems and contribute to the safe operation of transmission lines, with significant implications for power grid maintenance and disaster prevention strategies.

articleTitle: A Review of Degradation Prediction Methods for Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs), as a new type of clean and pollution-free power generation device, have the advantages of high energy conversion efficiency, low noise and fast start-up. However, the operation of PEMFCs is affected by multiple factors, and degradation problems are inevitable. Such degradation issues may cause safety hazards, reduce energy conversion efficiency and shorten their service life. Therefore, accurately predicting the degradation process is crucial for developing reliable and durable PEMFCs. This study reviews fuel cell degradation prediction models from three perspectives: model-based, data-driven, and fusion approaches. The study mentioned above is finally discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Defect Identification of Glass Insulators in Transmission Lines Based on Target Detection and Insulator String Trajectory Fitting
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a method for identifying glass insulator burst in transmission lines based on target detection and insulator string trajectory fitting. The color image and distance information of the insulator string are obtained by the depth camera. The position of the center point of each insulator is obtained by ellipse detection, and the track line of the center point of the insulator is obtained by fitting. In addition, the location of the target frame of the connecting plates on both sides of the insulator string is obtained through target detection, and the boundary of the track line of the center point of the insulator is obtained as a constraint. Each coordinate point is matched with the distance information of its corresponding point to obtain a discrete sequence of distance values. After outlier removal, interpolation and smoothing processing, the number of minimum points in the sequence is taken as the number of insulator pieces, so as to determine whether there is a phenomenon of insulator burst. The above method can accurately and effectively determine whether the glass insulator string has a flake explosion phenomenon, and can be applied to the power visual inspection equipment (including drones, image and video monitoring devices, etc.) and its analysis background to quickly discover and locate the problem, which helps the operation and maintenance personnel of the power company quickly eliminate the anomaly of the glass insulator string, reduce the operation risk of the power grid, and reduce the power outage accident.

articleTitle: Application and Validation of Beidou-3 Satellite Technology in the Field of UAV Inspection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The official application of Beidou-3 satellite provides higher quality positioning services for unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous inspection and other spatial location requirements of the power grid. We are building a Beidou power service network, applying the Beidou three frequency solution algorithm to promote more accurate Beidou-3 satellite positioning in unmanned aerial vehicle, replacing the original external positioning services. Verification shows that the Beidou power network can provide stable and reliable positioning services for unmanned aerial vehicles, meet daily inspection business needs, and ensure the safety of core facilities in the power grid.

articleTitle: Anything-DT Modeling: A New Framework for Digital Twin Modeling of Wild Objects from a Single RGB Image
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Given the significant limitations of current digital twin modeling methods in practical applications, their lack of sufficient generalizability, and the inherent diversity and complexity of real-world objects and environments, digital twin modeling from a single RGB image in unconstrained scenarios faces several maj or challenges. In this paper, we first improve the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and propose the CSAM model, which enables more accurate segmentation of any object. Next, we introduce the Anything-DT Modeling framework, which cleverly integrates the CSAM object segmentation model with a vision-language model to accomplish digital twin modeling tasks using only a single image. The CSAM model can maintain high accuracy and efficiency in complex scenarios, providing high-quality input data for subsequent digital twin modeling. The framework fully utilizes the latest advances in computer vision and natural language processing, providing strong technical support for digital twin modeling, thereby ensuring the feasibility of digital twin modeling from a single RGB image. Compared with existing state-of-the-art methods, the Anything-DT Modeling framework demonstrates its ability to produce detailed and accurate digital twin models for a wide range of objects, showcasing promising potential in overcoming the limitations of current approaches.

articleTitle: Setting of Relay Protection Setting for Distributed Photovoltaic Access Distribution Network Based on GSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The widespread integration of distributed photovoltaic power generation systems has transformed the distribution network from a traditional single power grid to a multi power grid, resulting in poor sensitivity effects. Therefore, this paper proposes a relay protection setting method for distributed photovoltaic access distribution networks based on the GSA algorithm. Design the specific solution process of GSA algorithm and extract real-time data of relay protection settings for distributed photovoltaic access distribution network; Determine the target value of real-time relay protection setting data from both current and voltage aspects, correspond to matching conditions, and obtain the setting result. The experimental results show that the tuning sensitivity of the proposed method is higher than 95%, and it has good tuning effect.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Feature Fusion Based Network for Aerial-Ground Point Cloud Place Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Point cloud place recognition(PCPR) plays a key role in helping aerial-ground robotic systems navigate and understand their surroundings, especially when GPS signals are unavailable. However, the heterogeneity between point clouds collected by aerial and ground platforms poses challenges and severely affects the robustness and generalization of aerial-ground PCPR. New approaches are required to tackle the differences in how data from various sources are represented and to improve performance in challenging environments. To solve this issue, we introduce a hierarchical adaptive feature fusion network built on the feature pyramid network (FPN), which dynamically adjusts the importance of features at different scales, boosting those critical for place recognition tasks and minimizing the domain gap between diverse point clouds. The experimental results on benchmark datasets highlight the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved Market Mechanisms Task Allocation Method Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In intelligent logistics factories, robots face issues such as uneven resource allocation and low efficiency during handling tasks. This paper proposes a new task allocation algorithm combining improved market mechanisms and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). The algorithm eliminates the traditional bidding mechanism, introduces a leasing strategy, and aims to maximize residual profit while minimizing execution time. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method performs well in simulated containerized environments, effectively addressing complex task allocation and scheduling needs.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Hybrid Intelligent Enhancement Analysis and Control System for Stability of Large Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The following achievements have been made: in the research of the operation image model of the large power grid, a real-time operation image model of the large power grid has been proposed. Corresponding solutions or technologies such as serviceability calculation have been proposed for typical difficult problems in dynamic measurement data and analysis calculation. Combined with the production needs of demonstration projects, the overall architecture design of the large power grid image model has been proposed, and the interface with simulation data and measurement data has been established to establish the large power grid image model. We have designed and implemented intelligent analysis and decision-making functions for the static safety and dynamic response characteristics of the power grid, as well as a laboratory validation plan for the effectiveness of response driven stability discrimination and control measures. In the analysis of the evolution of transient safety and stability characteristics in electromagnetically systems, a technical route for power grid image model “prediction-planning-correction” state deduction has been proposed, providing basic materials for system state analysis under different operating conditions. We have established a provincial-level grid 10000 node point mixed simulation verification platform, which can be used to verify the effectiveness testing of prototypes in operating scenarios, and conducted research on demonstration project implementation plans.

articleTitle: Enhanced Task Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing: A Hybrid Approach Using Deep Q-Learning from Demonstrations and Heuristic Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The increasing demands of delay-sensitive and resource-intensive applications in the IoT era have made Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) a promising solution for task offloading to nearby edge servers. Effective offloading in MEC requires strategies that balance energy consumption and meet strict deadline constraints to support the limited battery life of IoT devices and ensure low latency. Traditional heuristic algorithms, like DECO, efficiently manage energy and deadlines through predefined rules, while reinforcement learning (RL) methods adapt dynamically in changing environments. This paper proposes a hybrid model, DQfD-DECO, which combines the advantages of DECO and Deep Q-learning from Demonstrations (DQfD). By leveraging demonstration-based learning, our approach enhances initial offloading decisions and refines them through adaptive reinforcement learning. Comparative performance analysis in dynamic MEC scenarios reveals that DQfD-DECO achieves a superior balance of energy efficiency and deadline satisfaction, outperforming traditional rule-based methods in adaptability to fluctuating conditions.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation of the Frequency Nadir in Power Systems Based on Virtual Inertia Constant of Grid-Following Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This study presents the method for the frequency nadir in power systems based on the virtual inertia constantization of grid-following electrochemical energy storage that solves the problem of poor analytical computation of power system frequency response, since the virtual inertia of grid-following energy storage is the irregular time-varying parameter, it is not possible to directly aggregate and solve for the system equivalent inertia time constant. The method enables the aggregation and calculation of the system equivalent inertia time constant, while incorporating the energy storage frequency regulation response module into the SFR model for the analytical solution of the system frequency response characteristics. Finally, the accuracy of the method is systematically demonstrated through numerical examples.

Author Keywords: the analytical solution of the system frequency response

articleTitle: Research on Double-Layer Scheduling of Multi-Energy Microgrid Systems Based on Rolling Optimization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The rapid expansion of the energy sector poses significant challenges in the efficient management of multi-energy micro-grid systems (MEMS), which are crucial for balancing energy supply and demand while optimizing operational costs. Thus, the development of an effective double-layer scheduling strategy is key to addressing these engineering challenges. In this paper, we introduce a novel double-layer scheduling framework that leverages rolling optimization to enhance the operational efficiency and economic performance of MEMS. Utilizing this framework, we conducted comprehensive numerical simulations to evaluate the system's response to various operational scenarios. Our results demonstrate that the proposed strategy significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of real-time performance and cost reduction, while effectively mitigating transformer overload issues. It is noted that the integration of renewable energy sources is markedly improved, leading to a more sustainable and resilient energy system.

articleTitle: Research on High-Precision Dynamic Adjustment Real-Time Control Technology for New Energy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In recent years, real-time control simulation has become increasingly needed in various scenarios such as on-site debugging and preliminary verification of new energy power electronic converters due to its significant advantages. To solve the problem of significant differences between the control part of the simulation of new energy power electronic converters built using traditional modeling methods and the control system of actual digital chips, a modeling method that can be compared to the control system framework of actual digital chips in MATLAB/Simulink was designed, mainly including S-Function module call, callback function configuration The steps of C file calling, variable interaction between modules, module parallelism, and building an RT-Lab real-time control platform can achieve high-precision real-time control of new energy power electronic converters, and support online dynamic adjustment. Then, using the RT-Lab platform as a real-time controller combined with an actual power electronic converter, the correctness of the S-Function code execution designed according to the modeling method described in this article and the stable and good control effect of the new energy control system during stable operation and low voltage ride through were verified.

articleTitle: Configuration Tree-Based Network Device Parameter Generation and Deployment Framework
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As the scale of networks continues to expand, the automated management of network device parameters becomes increasingly important. This paper proposes a configuration tree-based framework for the generation and deployment of network device parameters, focusing primarily on routers and switches. Firstly, in the parsing phase, we utilize YANG models and YIN files to perform feature parsing on the parameter configuration files, abstracting intermediate configuration templates from the collected network configuration information. Secondly, in the parameter generation phase, based on the optimal matching mapping rules of nodes, new configuration files for required services are generated from the intermediate configuration templates. Finally, in the deployment phase, the configuration files are deployed to the devices through OF-CONFIG. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of this framework.

articleTitle: Multivariate Load Forecasting Model Based on MTL-LSTM-TCN
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This study introduces a multi-task learning (MTL) model that integrates a temporal convolutional network (TCN) with a long-short-term memory network (LSTM) for short-term multivariate load forecasting. Initially, the input features undergo preprocessing to ensure data quality and consistency. The MTL framework and LSTM are then employed to capture the interdependencies among multivariate loads and the temporal characteristics of load sequences, while TCN is leveraged to extract critical features from local patterns. This approach culminates in the development of the MTL-LSTM-TCN multivariate load forecasting model, aimed at enhancing the precision of multivariate load predictions. A simulation study was performed using a multivariate load dataset from Arizona State University's Tempe campus. The findings confirm that the proposed MTL-LSTM-TCN model delivers outstanding performance across various load forecasting scenarios, significantly boosting both the accuracy and robustness of short-term load predictions.

articleTitle: Power Detection Image Recognition Analysis Based on Image Fusion Extended Training
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The operation and maintenance of power system are paid more and more attention. How to solve the contradiction between economic development and electric power construction is the key problem faced by the development of the current national power industry. Image recognition technology realizes the transformation from artificial to intelligent power grid in power system operation and maintenance. With the help of computer vision algorithms and deep learning modes, the automatic detection and remote control of power system equipment and lines are realized. Image recognition techniques generate desired image samples through image synthesis algorithms, but the lack of image samples in power inspection leads to poor performance of the recognition algorithm. To solve this problem, this chapter gives two methods to expand the sample of power inspection. Firstly, the image synthesis algorithm based on image fusion is introduced. For some samples, the Poisson fusion algorithm is used to smooth the gradient of the boundary. Then, the image generation algorithm is introduced and the required samples are directly generated through Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGAN). Finally, two sample set augmentation methods are evaluated by experiments. Experiments are conducted to evaluate the effect of the two sample augmentation methods. In the experiment, the F1-score of the trained detection model on the same test set is improved from 0.802 to 0.873 after using image fusion to expand the training set. After using the images generated by DCGAN to expand the training set, the F1-score of the trained detection model on the same test set is improved from 0.769 to 0.877 after using image fusion to expand the training set, 12.3% increase. The F1-score of the trained detection model on the same test set is improved from 0.769 to 0.877 after using image fusion to expand the training set, 12.3% increase.

articleTitle: Status Assessment of Transmission Line Poles and Towers Based on Multi-Technology Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Focusing on the operation and maintenance problems of transmission line poles and towers in alpine regions, developing digital model of tower status evaluation technology based on multi-technology integration and development of multi-rotor uav navigation system based on Beidou + inertia. The components of the transmission line tower monitoring system are introduced in detail, including the technical parameters and functions of wire / insulator wind bias Angle and tension monitoring, intelligent micro-meteorological collection and other units, as well as the calculation method of tower force model and wire ice cover. Through multi-technology synergy, it aims to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the operation and maintenance of transmission lines in alpine and cold regions, and ensure the reliable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: A Novel Non-Intrusive Load Decomposition Approach Based on TCN with RFAM Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the growing diversification and operational flexibility of load-side resources, improving electricity consumption efficiency through precise load management has become increasingly critical. While non-intrusive load decomposition (NILD) offers an effective solution for household energy monitoring, existing techniques face critical limitations, including inadequate spatial feature extraction and insufficient attention to complex operational patterns. This study presents an enhanced NILD framework that integrates a Receptive-Field Attention Mechanism (RFAM) within an improved Temporal Convolutional Network architecture to address these challenges. The proposed RFAM-TCN synergistically optimizes spatial feature perception through adaptive weight allocation across convolutional layers while enhancing multi-scale temporal pattern recognition. Validated on the AMPds dataset, the model demonstrates superior decomposition accuracy compared to conventional approaches, achieving a 6.47<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> improvement in regression performance over BiLSTM-based solutions.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Assisted Generation Method of Typical Electrical Switching Operation Tickets Based on Topology Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The complexity of the power grid has increased, and the operation of electrical switches has become a complex topology process. The traditional manual generation of operation tickets has shortcomings. This article combines topology analysis and distributed multi-agent theory to design an auxiliary generation method, including coordinating, generating, and verifying agents, to achieve information sharing through agent interaction. Use RBF neural network to generate operation tickets and infer the order of device switches. The results show that this method can accurately generate operation tickets that are consistent with history, with high usability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi Energy Collaborative Optimization Model for Integrated Energy System Under Multi-Mode Ice Storage Air Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The research mainly investigates the impact of two different working modes of ice storage cooling systems on the planning and optimization of comprehensive energy systems, as well as the planning and optimization methods. Firstly, the planning and design of the comprehensive energy system is carried out by integrating equipment such as electric boilers, ground-source heat pumps, and ice storage cooling systems to construct the network structure of the comprehensive energy system. Secondly, the article establishes equipment output models and energy balance constraints, with the objective of minimizing the total investment over the entire life cycle, and uses genetic algorithms for planning and design. Finally, taking a certain park in the north as an example, the optimal configuration of equipment for the comprehensive energy system in the park is obtained under the operation condition of full ice melting of the ice storage cooling system, and the relationship between the peak-valley electricity price difference and the selection of operation schemes is analyzed. The results show that when the peak-valley electricity price difference is small, the system chooses to plan and design with partial ice melting operation condition of the ice storage.

articleTitle: Robust Time-Delay Optimal Control of 1,3-Propylene Batch Fermentation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Based on the established nonlinear time-delay dynamical system, a time-delay optimal control model with continuous state inequality constraints is established, taking the maximum yield of 1, 3-propylene glycol at terminal time as the performance index under the premise of determining the optimal parameters. The numerical results showed that the yield of 1, 3-propylene glycol was obviously increased at the terminal time.

articleTitle: Chain Fault Path Analysis and Risk Assessment Based on Accident Chain Modeling
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The occurrence of initial faults in distribution networks may often induce a series of chain reactions, which in turn cause significant losses. In order to completely assess the impacts caused by chained faults, a chained fault evolution path prediction and risk assessment method based on the accident company model is proposed. Based on the source fault set, the lower level open branch indicators and the depth-first algorithm, the evolution path of the accident chain of chain faults is predicted. Based on the accident chain model and risk metrics calculation, the consequences of fault risk are assessed and the weak links in the fault scenario are identified. Finally, taking the IEEE69 node system as an example, the accident chain model is constructed, the risk of chained faults is calculated, and the branch importance is evaluated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Landing and Positioning of Indoor Substation Inspection Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based on Machine Vision Assisted Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: If the indoor substation inspection drone deviates from the predetermined position during landing, it may collide with important and expensive equipment such as distribution cabinets and transformers in the substation room, causing damage and affecting the stability of power supply. To this end, a method for automatic landing and positioning of indoor substation inspection unmanned aerial vehicles based on machine vision assisted technology is studied. Capture and transmit landing information of indoor substation inspection unmanned aerial vehicles through multispectral cameras and self-organizing network communication technology; Gaussian filtering, wavelet decomposition, and bilateral filtering algorithms based on machine vision assisted technology are used to enhance drone landing images; Constructing a reference coordinate system for automatic landing and positioning of indoor substation inspection drones; The center position of the landing target is determined using a kernel correlation filter, and the landing image is segmented. The residual learning network is used to optimize the automatic landing positioning of the indoor substation inspection drone. The experimental results show that after enhancing the drone image, the brightness, contrast, and clarity of the image are significantly improved; The landing position coordinates obtained by this method are relatively close to the actual position coordinates, with small average center offset and average positioning error, which improves the accuracy of automatic landing positioning for indoor substation inspection drones.

articleTitle: Research on Sharpening Enhancement Techniques for Trace Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper investigates sharpening enhancement techniques for trace images, aiming to improve the identification capabilities of these images at crime scenes. It employs adaptive sharpening algorithms and gradient sharpening algorithms for preprocessing various types of trace images. Variance-based adaptive sharpening automatically adjusts sharpening parameters based on the specific content of the image to achieve optimal sharpening effects. It dynamically applies sharpening filters by analyzing local features in the image, such as edges and textures, thereby enhancing the details and clarity of the image. In gradient sharpening, the Laplacian operator is a commonly used image edge detection operator that can effectively highlight edge information in the image. During the sharpening process, the Laplacian operator enhances edge contrast by calculating the second-order derivative of the image, making the image edges clearer and the colors more vivid. Although adaptive sharpening can also improve image clarity to a certain extent, its effect is slightly less pronounced than that of Laplacian sharpening when dealing with complex trace images. Laplacian sharpening excels in highlighting the contrast between trace images and background images, effectively enhancing the clarity of image edges and the vividness of colors. This technique lays a solid foundation for subsequent edge detection and feature extraction. The innovation of this study lies in the systematic comparison of multiple sharpening algorithms and their effectiveness in trace image processing, providing new ideas and methodologies for research in related fields.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Navigation Using ORB-SLAM3: A Multi-Modal Autonomous System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Indoor mobile robots require reliable solutions for mapping, localization, and navigation tasks. This paper presents a mobile robot system that implements the ability to realize mapping using visual SLAM with ORB-SLAM3 and LiDAR-based mapping with Gmapping for indoor perception and navigation through a modular ROS architecture. The framework also implements autonomous navigation and an autonomous Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (RRT) exploration module with adaptive reset mechanisms. The system operates on a ROS-based platform equipped with an Intel RealSense D435i RGB-D camera and LDS-02 LiDAR scanner. Experimental validation in simulated indoor environments demonstrates the system's capabilities and the presented architecture achieves computational efficiency through selective utilization of mapping modules while maintaining mapping accuracy through complementary sensor modalities.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Safety Monitoring and Early Warning Technology for High-Altitude Power Work
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This article explores the background and significance of monitoring the working status of power high-altitude workers, pointing out that high-altitude work is the key to the stable operation of the power system. However, workers face various challenges, such as fatigue and increased risk of safety accidents due to prolonged work. The existing technical solutions have problems such as difficult monitoring, real-time performance, and cost. To solve these problems, this article proposes a fatigue monitoring scheme based on modified safety helmets, integrating multiple modules to achieve real-time monitoring and early warning, using multi frame fusion algorithms and other technical means to improve accuracy and stability, achieving linkage with the power grid system, and providing reliable safety guarantees for high-altitude power workers.

articleTitle: Research on Asymmetric Fault Ride Through Control Strategy for Wind Power Based on Three Sequence Current
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Asymmetric faults in wind farms may cause fluctuations in active and reactive power, leading to a sharp drop in voltage. In order to reduce the impact of negative sequence current components, balance power fluctuations, and assist in wind turbine low-voltage fault crossing, the power model of grid connected converters during asymmetric faults in wind farms is analyzed, and traditional asymmetric fault control strategies are improved. A wind power asymmetric fault crossing control strategy based on zero sequence current is proposed, zero sequence currents are introduced to construct a zero sequence current control loop, which reduces the negative sequence current component generated by asymmetric faults in the wind farm and the fluctuation of active power in the wind farm, stabilizes the bus voltage. Finally, simulation confirms that the zero sequences current component improves the distribution of positive and negative sequence power, and reduces the fluctuation of grid connected current.

articleTitle: An MILP Approach Based Optimization Techniques for Offshore Wind Farms Electrical Collector Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The sizing and placement of the lines between the offshore substation (OS) and the wind turbines (WTs) are optimized using the mixed integer linear programming-based approach to large-scale offshore wind farm collector system planning (OWF-CSP) that we offer in this work. In order to guarantee the radiality of the topology of the offshore wind farm's collector system and expedite the solution process, we discover that the problem is comparable to distribution system planning, where topological constraints from Distribution Network Extension Planning (DNEP) are implemented. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by a case study based on an OWF with 42 fixed-location WTs. The OWF-CSP approach suggested in this paper reduces the computational time with the aid of radiality constraints and lowers the investment cost and power loss on the cables in comparison to the conventional design.

articleTitle: Study on the Normalization Method of the Influence of Detection Distance on Ultraviolet Imaging of Corona Discharge
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Observe distance has significant influence on the detection result of Ultraviolet(UV) imaging, in order to normalize the detection result of different observe distance to a uniform distance, Corona discharge facular regions in UV images were segmented with image processing algorithms and the facular area parameter was defined in this paper, then using rod-plane gap corona discharge model, the facular area and photons number parameters vary characteristic with the detection distance under different discharge intensity were researched, using Least-square curve fitting algorithm, the relationship of the above two parameters with distance were analyzed, fitting analysis showed that the fitting curves approximate meet the power function relationship. According to the characteristic of fitting function's exponent value with different discharge intensity were close, the exponent value were averaged and then we got the unified fitted functions expression. Based on the above research, the normalized calculation formulas were deduced; practical tests showed that the formulas had high normalization accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on User Adjustable Power Load Forecasting Method Based on Deep Learning and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rapid development of intelligent power system and demand-side management technology, accurate prediction and reasonable regulation of user adjustable load play a key role in improving the operation efficiency of power grid and promoting the consumption of new energy. This article proposes a load schedulability evaluation method based on the combination of deep learning and clustering analysis. This method utilizes the TSMixer network to model user historical load data, capturing the correlation between time series characteristics and features through time mixing and feature mixing methods. Combined with K-means clustering algorithm, the historical daily load data of users were clustered, and the adjustable load potential of users under each clustering mode was investigated. Then, this study used the TSMixer network to predict the user's load data in the future day, and classified the predicted results into the most similar clustering mode, so as to evaluate the adjustable load in the future day. The experimental results show that the TSMixer model has good predictive performance. At the same time, comparative analysis demonstrates that the load adjustability evaluation method proposed in this study, based on load prediction, outperforms existing methods.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Scale Simulation of Integrated Energy System Based on Finite Difference Approximation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
