abstract: The time scale span of energy transmission in the electric gas thermal integrated energy system is enormous, and the mathematical modeling of dynamic processes in multi-energy flow systems at different time scales is very complex. The simulation efficiency and accuracy of multi-energy flow systems are difficult to balance, and the accurate characterization of system response faces great challenges. In response to the above issues, this paper proposes a multi-time scale simulation method of integrated energy systems based on finite difference approximation. Firstly, the partial differential equations of gas and heat pipelines are discretized using the finite difference approximation theory, and a dynamic model involving time delay in gas and heat pipelines is established. Secondly, according to the breadth-first traversal algorithm, network constraints are met to connect coupled devices and networks. Finally, the simulation of the real operating state of the system when encountering small disturbances or faults verifies that the dynamic model proposed in this paper can significantly reduce the complexity and computational volume of the model, and improve simulation efficiency while ensuring accuracy.

articleTitle: Temperature Distribution Measurement and Simulation of Transmission Line Arrester Under Impulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Arrester is an important protection device for transmission lines. Due to the complex weather conditions and harsh operating environment, line arrester failures occur from time to time, affecting the normal operation of the power system. In this paper, a fluorescence optical fiber temperature measurement system for line arresters is built. The temperature changes of zinc oxide valve plates at different positions under two operating conditions of continuous operating voltage and switching impulse overvoltage are studied. The finite element simulation model of line arrester is established, and the electro-thermal coupling simulation of arrester is carried out. The calculation results are in good agreement with the test results. The valve plate defects are set in the simulation model, and the influence of defect position and defect number on the temperature distribution characteristics of arrester is studied.

articleTitle: Intelligent Geological Subsidence Prediction Based on PSO-RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Land subsidence is a threat to the safe and stable operation of transmission lines, and it is very likely to lead to the movement and deformation of transmission line tower foundations. In this paper, a particle swarm optimization radial basis function neural network (PSO-RBF) method is used to predict the geological settlement. For RBF neural network hidden layer center, width varies according to different applications, PSO-RBF uses particle swarm algorithm to find the optimal parameters, optimize the RBF neural network mechanism and the global convergence of the algorithm, and then establish the PSO-RBF neural network prediction method for land subsidence. This paper verifies the applicability of pso-rbf neural network in surface subsidence and compares the results with the traditional BP neural network, RBF neural network, and PSO-BP neural network pairs for predicting land subsidence, and the results show that the prediction results perform better than the other three models in the application of the land subsidence prediction case.

articleTitle: Application Research of Micromagnetic Prediction Intelligent Model for Residual Elongation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Based on the principle of micromagnetic detection, an intelligent model for quantitative characterization of residual elongation of interstitial free (IF) steel was established. Firstly, specimens with different residual elongation were prepared by tensile test mechanism. Then, the magnetic signal of the tested part is tested by using the micromagnetic sensor. Then, a neural network model is established based on the data detected by the sensor to realize the quantitative characterization of residual elongation. The results show that the micromagnetic testing method can predict the residual elongation of IF steel quantitatively and nondestructively, and the maximum relative error of residual elongation obtained by the model is less than 30%. This method is universal in different testing systems. The proposed research methods and conclusions can provide reference for micromagnetic nondestructive testing of residual elongation of ferromagnetic materials.

articleTitle: Design of Measurement and Control System of Suspension Support Device Based on LabView and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To ensure flight safety of newly developed aircraft model, it is necessary to conduct wind tunnel stability tests of a scaled-down aircraft model under support of a multi-degree-of-freedom suspension support device in a wind tunnel. In this paper, measurement and control system of the suspension support device is designed to adjust aircraft model's attitude and collect information from various sensors of the support device. The measurement and control system was designed based on LabVIEW and FPGA; FPGA control board is responsible for servo motor control, and control and measurement software system was built by using LabVIEW. This system is responsible for signal transmission and reception, data processing, and storage. Following experimental verification, it has been demonstrated that the measurement and control system designed in this paper can meet requirements of parallel processing of multiple data types, large amounts of information, and aircraft model attitude control during the test.

articleTitle: Consider PV Participation in Electricity and Frequency Regulation Market Trading Mechanisms That Include Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy, the role of photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage systems in the electricity market is becoming increasingly important. In this paper, based on a joint clearing model of the electric energy and frequency regulation markets for thermal power units and energy storage systems, the effect of PV power generation participation in the electric energy market is analysed, and the cost minimisation problem is explored for both scenarios of adding new energy sources (PV) and not adding new energy sources. The study assumes that PV generation does not participate in the frequency regulation market, but is cleared as part of the electric energy market. The impact of the inclusion of PV on the dispatch costs in the electricity market is analysed by comparing the system operating costs in the two scenarios. The results show that although PV generation does not participate in the frequency regulation dispatch in the electricity market, its inclusion can still effectively reduce the overall system operating costs PV output is able to replace part of the burden of thermal power units, thus achieving cost optimisation.

articleTitle: Enhanced LiDAR SLAM Backend with Multi-Session Mode for Long-Term Association
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Intelligent devices necessitate long-term, precise pose estimation and mapping to effectively perceive and describe the real world. To address this challenge, we propose an enhanced optimization and mapping module for the long-term association LiDAR SLAM back-end, based on a multi-session mode. We utilize an iVox-based point cloud registration method to enhance the speed of loop detection and dynamic point removal in point cloud maps. By employing a Distributed Pose Graph Optimization (DPGO) method, we associate data from multiple LiDAR sessions, facilitating information sharing between pose graphs and reducing their complexity. This approach significantly improves the speed of global pose optimization. Experimental results regarding computational efficiency, trajectory accuracy, and the quality of long-term point cloud maps demonstrate that our module enhances the existing LT -Mapper algorithm. Our module effectively reduces the time required for point cloud registration, enhances both the efficiency and accuracy of pose map optimization, and results in more precise long-term pose estimation.

articleTitle: The Error Prediction Method for Voltage Transformers Based on the EGO-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The operation management of voltage transformers tends to focus on long-term monitoring, lacking real-time online condition assessment methods. Therefore, this paper utilizes the measurement data from the transformer for data mining and exploration. It studies the combination of the EGO (Efficient Global Optimization) algorithm and LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), using the prediction function and error function of the parallel EGO-LSTM model as the foundation to derive analytical expressions combining the sample distribution probability density function and the cumulative distribution function. Then, using the PIE (Pseudo Expected Improvement) criterion, new sample points are selected to update the parameters of the prediction model. Finally, the optimized LSTM model is used to predict the error data of the voltage transformer. To verify the superiority of the proposed algorithm, it is compared with other optimization algorithms, and simulation results show that the prediction error of this method is generally lower than that of other optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Multiple Regression Methods Based Core Rod Localization for Composite Insulators Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This study aims to detect the temperature rise of the core rod of composite insulators through infrared image thermography to assess their operating condition in the power system. Initially, the infrared images of composite insulators were preprocessed using image erosion to reduce the error of the skirt mask and highlight the core rod. Subsequently, linear regression methods were applied to the eroded images to separate the core rod and obtain its temperature distribution. The study compared four regression methods: ordinary least squares, ridge regression, Lasso regression, and Elastic Net regression, and evaluated the significance of the models using an F-test.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Power Big Data Imbalance Analysis Based on Deep Learning OCR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and intelligent equipment, the power industry generates a large amount of real-time data, which constitutes “power big data”. These data are widely used in power system optimization, fault diagnosis, energy efficiency management and other fields. However, in practical applications, power big data often suffers from data imbalance. In this paper, an unbalanced analysis method for power big data based on deep learning OCR algorithm is proposed. First, the common types of data information and their imbalance phenomenon in electric power big data are analyzed, and the impact of data imbalance on the electric power big data analysis model is discussed. Secondly, the basic principles of deep learning technology and OCR algorithm are introduced, and an improved processing method is proposed for the imbalance problem in electric power big data by combining deep learning OCR technology. Finally, by optimizing data preprocessing, feature extraction, sampling strategy and loss function, the application effect of OCR algorithm in electric power data is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Lightning Ignition Source Control Technology for Aircraft Fuel Tank Structure
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the match between the design features of typical wing parts and the lightning current environment by comparing and analyzing the parameters (1): lightning spark threshold of sample pieces designed according to the structural characteristics of aircraft and the parameters (2): lightning simulation current of certain structures of aircraft. A useful method is summarized through the process of comparison, with which the ignition source of the aircraft fuel tank can be effectively controlled combined with the known aircraft lightning environment simulation model.

articleTitle: Electrical Fast Transient/Burst (EFT/B) for Outdoor Mobile Power
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Radiated emission testing is vital for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of electronic devices. Amorphous magnetic rings possess unique properties that make them well-suited for this testing. These rings lack long-range atomic order, resulting in high magnetic permeability, low coercivity, and improved soft magnetic properties. This research investigates the application of amorphous magnetic rings in radiated emission testing, exploring their advantages over conventional materials. By bridging the fields of radiated emission testing and amorphous magnetic materials, this thesis aims to contribute to the development of more efficient and accurate EMC testing methodologies. It strives to enhance electromagnetic compatibility in our interconnected world.

articleTitle: The Research on Angular Momentum Conservation and Resistance in the Balance of an Upright Rod Under Computer Simulation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper investigates the design and implementation of an intelligent stabilization system for an upright rod based on angular momentum conservation. The system uses an ESP32 controller with FreeRTOS for multi-task scheduling and high-precision sensors, including the MPU6050 and AS5600. An improved LQR controller with Kalman filtering handles the control algorithm. The system achieves wind resistance of up to 10.96 m/s and can restore stability within 3 seconds, with a maximum deflection angle of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1^{\circ}$</tex>. Experimental data confirm the system's effectiveness.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based UAV Visual Recognition System in Distribution Network Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Distribution line project acceptance is a key link in the quality control of distribution line grid project, which is an important factor affecting the safe and stable operation of distribution network and directly determines the level of safe operation of distribution network. In order to solve the problem of long distribution network lines, complex and large amount of equipment, manual acceptance is time-consuming and laborious, and to improve the efficiency of field work and scientific decision-making ability. In this paper, we propose a small target inspection network CMH-YOLOv5 based on CBAM attention mechanism and tiny target detection head. Compared with the original YOLOv5, the main improvements are the use of attention mechanism in the shallow layer of the network and the addition of a tiny target detection head to introduce the attention module to improve the performance of target detection. Optimization improves the efficiency of inspection work, provides empirical evidence for the engineering turn-around sequence, improves the field efficiency and scientific decision-making ability, and realizes the digital transformation of UAV operation in the direction of power system infrastructure engineering.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Trading Mechanism Based on Supply-Demand Ratio Pricing and Fair Clearing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: For distributed energy systems, an energy trading mechanism involving shared energy storage is proposed. This mechanism sets the internal transaction price according to the supply and demand of the system, and encourages the producers and consumers to adopt the optimal sharing strategy with the energy suppliers to maximize the system benefits and achieve the optimal social welfare. At the same time, the clearing algorithm based on the ideal profit realization rate is adopted to ensure fairness among participants and improve user satisfaction. The results show that the improved supply-demand pricing mechanism can effectively stimulate the enthusiasm of producers and consumers to participate in the market, and the shared energy storage trading mechanism can significantly improve the social welfare of the system. The clearing scheme based on the ideal profit realization rate can distribute profits according to the contribution degree of prosumers, and ensure the fairness of the system trading mechanism.

articleTitle: Refined Resource Allocation Algorithm for Power Trading Centers Based on User Service Needs
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To learn more about the optimization of energy exchange centre, this paper puts forward a new kind of optimized resource assignment algorithm based on customer service requirements. Then, according to the history of the history of energy supply, it is classified as environmental protection, transport resource conservation, economic efficiency, and so on. Finally, we put forward a kind of energy information matching arithmetic and integrated evaluating function to satisfy the optimum distribution of electric power. Simulated results show that this method can increase the proportion of NEP used in the transaction, and enhance the ability of distribution of the electricity network.

articleTitle: Lightweight Identity Authentication Algorithm for Electric Energy Measurement Terminals Based on Device Fingerprints and Timestamps
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Due to the limitation of hardware resources, handheld detection devices face challenges such as limited computing power, restricted storage space and restricted operating environment, which make the authentication vulnerable to security threats and may lead to forgery or fraudulent use of terminal identity. To address the above issues, this paper proposes an anti-forgery identity authentication method based on device fingerprints and timestamps. First, a device-specific fingerprint with high anti-forgery performance is extracted using authentication technology. Then, the uniqueness of event occurrences is guaranteed by the non-counterfeitability of device fingerprints and timestamps, reducing the possibility of deception and impersonation. Finally, the device identity, fingerprint, and timestamp are integrated to design an authentication mechanism that prevents forgery, thus realizing a “one-time pad” encryption scheme in the key verification process. It was demonstrated through experimental results that the proposed method is effective in resisting man-in-the-middle attacks and enhancing forgery prevention.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Automatic Tobacco Baking System Based on Multi-Source Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rapid growth of tobacco market demand and the gradual aging of traditional roasting technology, automated tobacco roasting system has become an important means to improve production efficiency and guarantee tobacco quality. In this study, an automated tobacco roasting system based on multi-source data fusion is designed to collect environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity and airflow in the roasting process in real time through IoT devices and edge computing, and combine with deep learning and fuzzy control algorithms to achieve accurate regulation of the roasting curve. The system adopts a modular structure, including a data acquisition and monitoring module, an intelligent algorithm processing unit and a feedback control system, to ensure the efficient and stable operation of the roasting process. In the experimental process, through the comparison and verification of the automated process and traditional process, it is found that the automated system shows significant advantages in the proportion of top-grade tobacco, unit cost and error rate control: the proportion of top-grade tobacco is increased to 50.12%, the unit cost is reduced by 29%, and the error rate is reduced to 0.23%. The system not only greatly improves the appearance quality and market competitiveness of tobacco, but also realises the dynamic adaptation to different varieties of tobacco, providing theoretical basis and practical support for the intelligent development of the tobacco industry.

articleTitle: Micro-Topographic Feature Extraction for High Wind Risk Prediction of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In complex terrain regions, particularly under extreme wind conditions, transmission lines are highly susceptible to significant incidents such as wind-induced flashover and line breakage. However, current meteorological models often lack sufficient accuracy in addressing wind speed variations caused by micro-topography, which hinders precise risk predictions. This study proposes a micro-topographic feature extraction method tailored for high-wind risk prediction of transmission lines. By integrating an improved UNet model with the DBSCAN clustering algorithm, this approach enables accurate extraction and classification of disaster-prone micro-topographies, such as ridges and valleys, thus providing a foundation for high-wind early warnings. The method begins by using an enhanced UNet model to identify key terrain features, including peaks, ridges, and valleys. Then, DBSCAN density-based clustering is applied to refine the segmentation, isolating high-risk micro-topographic areas with increased wind exposure. Additionally, ECMWF wind field data are coupled with terrain information, while local wind field analysis, facilitates high-precision high-wind risk warnings within micro-topographic zones. Enhanced feature extraction precision further supports refined high-wind forecasting capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that this method achieves outstanding performance in both disaster-prone terrain feature extraction and regional classification. The generated dynamic risk maps provide robust early warning and decision-making support for the safe operation of transmission lines and show promise for broader applications in meteorological risk prediction across other complex terrains.

articleTitle: Attention Mechanism-Enhanced Multi-scale Separable Atrous Convolution Method for Motor Bearing Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To address the issue of inadequate feature information extraction by single convolutional neural networks in high-noise environments, which leads to suboptimal diagnostic performance, this study proposes an attention mechanism-enhanced Multi-scale Atrous Separable Convolution (MASC) method for motor bearing fault diagnosis. The proposed method begins by performing overlapping sampling on motor bearing data, using the original time-series signals as inputs to the neural network to preserve the integrity of the original signals. Subsequently, a MASC module is designed for feature extraction; the MASC includes an efficient convolutional module with a residual structure to extract features from the input data while maximizing the retention of valuable information. Next, a channel-wise attention mechanism is constructed to perform feature selection on the extracted data. Finally, after mapping through a fully connected layer, these features are input into a softmax layer for fault identification. Testing and validation were conducted using the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) dataset. At a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 0 dB, the proposed method achieved a fault diagnosis accuracy of 98.50%, further demonstrating its strong diagnostic capability in high-noise environments.

articleTitle: DSSC Device Simulation Modeling and Optimization Configuration Method Based on WOA
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As the proportion of renewable energy integration increases, power flow control issues in power grids become increasingly complex. This paper proposes a simulation modeling and optimization configuration method for power flow based on distributed static series compensator (DSSC). By constructing a DSSC electromechanical transient model, analyzing its working principle and regulation characteristics, and combining a power flow optimization model, this method achieves regional grid load balancing and improved power transmission efficiency. The whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is adopted to solve the optimization configuration problem. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulations based on the IEEE 39-bus system, providing new ideas for distributed grid regulation.

articleTitle: Analysis on a Resonance Faults Incident of 35kV Capacitor Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Capacitor voltage transformers (CVTs), as important online monitoring devices, have been widely used in power systems. Monitoring overvoltage waveforms through CVTs provides crucial information for fault location and troubleshooting. However, However, the internal dynamic and nonlinear components of CVTs, primarily designed for power frequency voltage measurements, can distort wideband lightning overvoltage waveforms, complicating fault analysis. This paper analyzes a typical power frequency resonance fault recorded by a 35 kV line CVT, examining the waveform distortions and ferroresonance process caused by the CVT fault under lightning overvoltage conditions. Simulation results show that when the damping circuit of the CVT is damaged, prolonged lightning waves can cause sustained power frequency resonance that cannot be eliminated. The research offers valuable references for analyzing similar overvoltage incidents.

articleTitle: VisionMamba-Based Multimodal Learning for Alzheimer's Disease and Mild Cognitive Impairment Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Early diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease (AD) and Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) is critical for delaying disease progression and improving patient outcomes. This study proposes a multimodal deep learning approach based on the VisionMamba framework, leveraging 2D MRI slice images as the primary imaging data source. By integrating cognitive scores (e.g., MMSE, FAQ) and demographic information (e.g., gender, age), the method achieves efficient and accurate classification of AD and MCI. In this approach, the VisionMamba structure is utilized to extract features from individual 2D MRI slices. These features are then combined with cognitive scores and demographic attributes through a multimodal fusion technique. Specifically, a late fusion strategy is adopted to integrate imaging and non-imaging features at the classification stage, enhancing the overall model performance. Experimental results demonstrate that the VisionMamba-based 2D imaging classification method outperforms traditional 3D image processing approaches in terms of accuracy, recall, and F1 score, while significantly reducing computational costs. This study underscores the potential of VisionMamba in leveraging 2D MRI slices and multimodal fusion techniques for efficient and scalable AD and MCI diagnosis. The findings highlight its capability to provide an accurate and computationally efficient solution for early detection.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Clearing Model of Electricity-Carbon Coupling Day Market Considering User Demand
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As an important source of carbon emissions, the power industry, coupled with the electricity spot market and carbon trading market, has become an important means of promoting low-carbon transformation. At the same time, the participation of the user side in the form of quoted quantity and price can promote fair competition, more truly reflect the market supply and demand and improve the efficiency of resource allocation. Based on this background, a two-stage clearing model of electricity-carbon coupling day market is established by categorizing users to take into account their demand for electricity and reduce system costs and carbon emissions. In the first stage, a clearing model is developed to maximize the social welfare by the users' quoted quantity. In the second stage, a clearing model is developed to minimize the system cost of power generation and carbon trading cost by users only offering quantity. Simulation and analysis on the improved PJM5 node system verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Failure Mechanism and Fault Prediction Method of High Voltage DC Relays
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As an important switching component, studying the fault prediction model of high-voltage direct current relays is of great significance for improving the power supply safety in the field of new energy. With the goal of analyzing the failure mechanism of high-voltage direct current relays and predicting their faults, a high-voltage direct current relay experimental system was built, and a large number of on-off experiments were conducted on multiple relays. BP and PSO-BP neural network prediction models were constructed using MATLAB, and arc energy was selected as the input feature quantity for the prediction model. The accuracy of the prediction model was evaluated using R2, MAE, MSE, and the results showed that the PSO- BP neural network prediction model is more suitable for fault prediction of high-voltage DC relays.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Dual Three-Phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Extended Virtual Control Set
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The model predictive control employed in traditional dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motors relies on a static voltage vector during a single control cycle, resulting in subpar motor performance. To address this issue, a model predictive control approach utilizing a triple synthetic virtual voltage vector is proposed. The control set can be extended by separating large vectors and medium vectors in phase, medium and small vectors in phase, and large and small vectors in opposite phase. Building on this foundation, the deadbeat principle is employed to identify the sector where the optimal virtual vector is situated, thereby decreasing the number of prediction computations from 37 to just 7. This streamlines the process of selecting the voltage vector. Ultimately, the practicality and efficiency of the proposed scheme are confirmed through experimental validation.

Author Keywords: dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: A Multi-Mode Three-Phase Bidirectional CLLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the V2G mode of new energy vehicles, this paper adopts three control strategies to make the three-phase CLLC resonant converter carry out energy transmission in half-bridge, full-bridge and three-phase mode respectively. In these three control modes, the three-phase CLLC resonant converter can not only achieve bidirectional power transmission, but also have different power transmission modes, so that it can be applied in different power demand scenarios. Therefore, a three-phase bidirectional CLLC resonant converter with fixed power of 2kW, rated input voltage of 400V and output voltage of 500V is designed in this paper. Finally, PLECS is used to verify the theoretical simulation results. The simulation results show that the designed three-phase bidirectional CLLC resonant converter can realize the bidirectional power transmission of three modes respectively.

articleTitle: Small Sample Maintainability Analysis of CNC Machine Tools
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the reliability of CNC machine tools, some subsystems of CNC machine tools show the characteristics of long life, less faults and less maintenance. In these long-life subsystems, not only the maintenance data distributed in each subsystem is less, but also the prior information about the maintainability of the subsystem is less. In view of this situation, the lognormal distribution model is transformed into a normal distribution model, and a normal distribution small sample modeling method without prior information is used to establish the maintainability model of each subsystem. It can be found that the MTTR of exchange table is the maximum, and the maintainability level is the lowest through the maintainability evaluation results. The conclusion lays a foundation for the improvement measures of machining center credibility.

articleTitle: A Novel Received Signal Strength Estimation Method for Wi-Fi Fingerprint-Based Indoor Positioning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Wi-Fi fingerprint-based indoor positioning technology has now been extensively studied. However, this technology commonly requires an offline site survey process for construction of the fingerprint database which is extremely time-consuming and labor-intensive, hampering its large-scale implementation. To handle this issue, this paper proposes a Wi-Fi received signal strength (RSS) estimation method based on Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) and Autoencoder. Specifically, this paper first leverages GPR to learn the noise characteristics of signals, and employs Autoencoder to reconstruct values of RSS. Then, by integrating the output of both models, an estimation of RSS can be obtained. Extensive experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of the fingerprint database reconstruction, compared with the traditional estimation algorithms, like standard GPR and K Nearest Neighbors (KNN).

articleTitle: A Time Space Feature Extraction Method for Scene Analysis Based on Spectral Clustering Theory
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: A method for extracting time space feature volume of power system scenes based on spectral clustering is proposed. Through downscaling and correlation processing of massive high-dimensional data, massive variables with both temporal and spatial characteristics dispersed in the power grid are clustered according to the similarity of their influence on the operation mode, and the time space feature volume applicable to the analysis of the power grid scenario is extracted. Classification and screening based on the extracted feature quantities, generating scenario patterns classified in time and space scales, and predicting the short-term operation mode of the power grid by analyzing historical electricity consumption data and multiple influencing factors

articleTitle: Research on UV Imaging Detection of Corona Discharge on Power Fittings
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Corona discharge is the most common discharge phenomenon in power transmission and transformation equipment, which indicates that there may be electrical defects in high voltage equipment. Through the ultraviolet imager, the 500 kV substation under different meteorological conditions was measured, and the metal parts with the most serious corona discharge phenomenon were found. At the same time, the above discharge phenomena are classified according to different discharge parts and the causes of discharge are analyzed. Finally, a comprehensive analysis method of discharge evaluation based on the discharge position, strength, shape and mechanism of the equipment and meteorological conditions is proposed.

articleTitle: Improved Differential Steering Control Algorithm for Intelligent Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Differential steering control for intelligent vehicles is one of the key technologies in automated control. Existing methods employ PID control for differential steering; however, these methods often suffer from speed fluctuations and poor stability. Therefore, we propose an improved differential control algorithm. By analyzing the current state and error information of the vehicle, we dynamically adjust the vehicle's speed using fuzzy control logic combined with differential proportional control, thereby enhancing the vehicle's stability and response speed in complex environments. Experimental results show that, compared to traditional PID control, this method effectively reduces speed fluctuations and improves the motion accuracy of the vehicle in nonlinear environments.

articleTitle: A Non-Contact Voltage Measurement Technology for Three-Phase Cables
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a non-contact measurement technique for the voltage of three-phase cables. The technique initially constructs an optimized analytical calculation model for the electric field distribution of three-phase cables. Subsequently, by combining measured electric field data from an array-type capacitive sensor and utilizing the potential coefficient matrix obtained through physical calculations, it enables precise determination of the voltages on the three-phase conductors. The maximum error does not exceed 3.3%.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Design and Simulation Analysis of 3.5MW Doubly-Fed Machine
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Based on the rated parameters and performance standards of the 3.5 MW doubly-fed machine, the electromagnetic design of the machine is carried out. The design of the stator and rotor inner and outer diameter dimensions, the number of pole pairs, the winding structure, and the number of slot slots of the 3.5MW doubly-fed machine are determined through the study of the machine design principles, formulas, and design experience. Subsequently, the ANSYS/RMxprt calculation module is used to input the design parameters into it, and the data of the machine's efficiency as well as the magnetic density of the stator and rotor teeth and yoke are calibrated to ensure the accuracy of the design. In order to deeply analyse the performance of the doubly-fed machine, the Maxwell 2D module is further used to carry out finite element analysis of the machine's operating state under no-load and load conditions. The reasonableness of the electromagnetic design scheme is proved from the distribution of magnetic lines of force, magnetic density cloud diagrams and various types of waveform diagrams.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Grid Line Defect Identification and Classification Methods in UAV Inspection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the development of the power system, the application of UAVs in distribution network inspection is becoming more and more widespread, therefore, this paper carries out research on the algorithms for distribution network line defects, solves the problems of fewer samples for acceptance of line engineering defects, poorer training effect, and lower model recognition accuracy, and researches a method for the identification and categorization of line defects in distribution networks. Firstly, through the sample data enhancement technique, the generalization ability of the model is improved, overfitting is reduced, and the robustness of the model to the input data is enhanced; secondly, the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) is introduced to generate the antagonistic samples, which significantly reduces the amount of computational effort; finally, in combination with the Transformer architecture, an algorithm applicable to the recognition of line defects of power distribution grids is proposed, which improves the algorithm's performance in the complex scenario. The experimental results show that the method in this paper has significant improvement in the accuracy of defect recognition, computational efficiency and anti-interference ability, which provides a new technical solution for distribution network line defect detection.

articleTitle: Variable Speed Wind Turbine Control System with Doubly-Fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As wind farms expand in size, it becomes increasingly important to evaluate the stability of the power system, including dynamic models for wind power generation. Among the most widely used generators today are doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs). These generators allow for the regulation of the reactive and active powers via the rotor-side converter, when the stator remains directly linked with the network. This paper examines the control of a variable-speed wind turbine (WT) that uses a DFIG, focusing on both steady-state and dynamic performance. − The control strategy is evaluated through simulation, demonstrating how variable-speed turbines with DFIG can regulate their output power, much like conventional power plants.

articleTitle: Detect and Minimize Reverse Power Flow in a Renewable Energy Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: High permeability of renewable energy into the power system can cause risks such as overvoltage, frequency variation, voltage deviation, reverse power flow (RPF), etc. This paper presents a method to detect and minimize the reverse power flow in a distribution system integrated with renewable energy. IEEE 13 bus with a monitor is mounted on the source bus to identify the reverse power flow used to test the system. To demonstrate the induction of reverse power flow, a PV system is connected at node 611 with a set capacity of 4000 kW. The load flow is performed using co-simulation between engines OpenDSS and MATLAB through component object model server dynamiclink library. Biogeography-based optimization (BBO) is applied to solve the multiple objective functions, including RPF at the substation and total load increase at each bus. Combining BBO and PSO can balance both global and local search capabilities. Results obtained by the proposed method show that the reverse power flow at the substation occurring due to the connection of large amounts of renewable energy sources can be significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Scheduling Strategy of Household Energy Management System Based on Multi-Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the penetration of distributed photovoltaic power generation on the user side, more and more families have independent photovoltaic power generation systems. Household energy management system play an important role in optimizing the allocation of power resources. This article based on the function of household energy management system, the working mode of household photovoltaic power generation system photovoltaic power generation system and ESD is analyzed and the corresponding mathematical model is established. Considering the loss cost of charging or discharging of energy storage device by household users, an optimal scheduling model of household flexible load is established, which takes into account the minimization of electricity cost and minimization of peaking ratio. Then, proposing an optimal scheduling strategy based on the management of energy storage device charging or discharging.

articleTitle: Control Method for Butterfly-Inspired Flapping-Wing Aircraft Using Fluid Dynamics Theory
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Conventional aircraft encounter aerodynamic limitations at small scales and low Reynolds numbers, restricting the coordination of factors such as lift and thrust generation, flapping motion patterns, and flapping frequencies in butterfly-inspired flapping-wing aircraft. Additionally, accurate analysis of their aerodynamic forces is challenging, leading to poor control accuracy and real-time performance for these aircraft. To address these issues, a control method for butterfly-inspired flapping-wing aircraft using fluid dynamics theory is proposed. The main governing equations of fluid dynamics for the butterfly-inspired flapping-wing aircraft are established using computational fluid dynamics methods. The forced vibration method is employed to solve for the aircraft's dynamic derivatives, and a PID control approach is used to design the control law. By integrating structured overlapping grid technology, a closed-loop PID controller, and rudder deflection control law, effective control of the aircraft's attitude is achieved. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method offers high control accuracy and efficiency for the butterfly-inspired flapping-wing aircraft, ensuring real-time control of the aircraft's motion attitude by the base station host.

articleTitle: The Study on Influence Factor of Vertical Transportation Pricing of Underground Substation Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The growing number of underground substations annually has brought the issue of pricing for vertical transportation to the forefront. A comprehensive and well-structured pricing standard for vertical transportation in these settings is urgently needed. The “Indicator System for Factors Influencing Vertical Transportation Pricing in Underground Substations” utilizes a hierarchical analysis approach, considering five key aspects: labor factors, mechanical factors, material factors, environmental factors, and equipment factors. This system provides a robust foundation for the future development of the Standard for Vertical Transportation Pricing in Underground Substations.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Power Generation Unit Triboelectric Nanogenerator
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators are widely used in micro-nano energy, self-powered sensors, blue energy and high-voltage power supplies, covering the fields of medicine, wearable electronics, flexible electronics, safety, man-machine interface and environmental science. Among them, micro-nano energy capture has the advantage of capturing high-entropy energy, which provides a new way for wind energy capture. In order to efficiently collect low-frequency wind energy, this paper proposes a mechanical frequency-pumped friction-electromagnetic hybrid generator based on the principle of friction nanogenerator and electromagnetic generator. The generator adopts a multi-convex nose cam mechanism to realize mechanical frequency increase and form a mechanical frequency pump. At the same time, the structure converts the rotational motion into a linear motion, so that the triboelectric nanogenerator module achieves a vertical contact-separation mode and reduces the loss of the friction material. The alternating magnetic field is integrated on the active part to form an electromagnetic generator module. The comprehensive design method proposed in this paper provides a new idea and new technical means for capturing wind energy, and has exploitable application value.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Graph of Power Defect Faults Based on Deep Neural Networks Considering Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the current problem that part evaluation and overall substation equipment evaluation are split and cannot be organically integrated, therefore, this paper proposes a deep neural network to build a knowledge graph based on the association relationship between equipment and parts considering the attention mechanism. First, a multilayer neural network model considering textual attention mechanism and relational attention mechanism is established to build a knowledge map for each substation equipment and its corresponding parts; second, the multilevel and multidimensional association relationships between parts and parts, parts and equipment, and equipment and equipment are analyzed from the electrical space and the physical space, and the equipment association network is formed; finally, based on the association relationships, the knowledge map of parts and equipment is Finally, the knowledge map of parts and devices is interactively mapped based on the association relationships to form a spatial association knowledge map that integrates electrical and physical associations and is oriented to the spatial associations among substation equipment, components, parts and devices.

articleTitle: Research on Staged Harmonic Prediction and Regulation Strategy Based on Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Under the background of the country's vigorous development of clean energy, China has put forward the strategic decision of “carbon peak, carbon neutral”. Distributed photovoltaic (PV) power generation has gradually entered a high boom development stage, and after years of development, the proportion of PV power generation system is getting bigger and bigger, which also leads to a variety of power electronic devices are put into the micro grid use, which really improves the efficiency of the microgrid work at the same time, but also makes the harmonic problem become more and more serious. In order to reduce the harmonic problems caused by the stability of the distribution network is affected by the problem, this paper through the different time periods under the photovoltaic grid-connected harmonic problems generated in the study. Firstly, the required harmonics are extracted using IP-IQ harmonic detection method, secondly, the harmonics are predicted and analyzed at different times by using different deep learning modules. And finally the current harmonics filtering in the grid is accomplished by eliminating the harmonics in the grid through an active filter (APF).

articleTitle: Research on Load Forecasting Based on Deep Learning Framework Optimized by Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Precise power load forecasting is crucial for maintaining the stable and efficient operation of power systems. To enhance predicted accuracy, this study introduces a hybrid forecasting approach that integrates Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) with deep learning framework. Convolutional neural network (CNN) is employed to capture nonlinear relationships among factors influencing power load, generating high-quality feature representations. Then the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) optimizes the parameters of the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to enhance its fitting ability to handle raw load data. Subsequently, the LSTM models the time-dependence of power loads and accurately captures the short-term fluctuation characteristics. Finally, the Attention mechanism is incorporated to assign weights to the input features, emphasizing critical features and improving the prediction accuracy. The experimental findings indicate that, compared with alternative models, the proposed CNN-SSA-LSTM-Attention model attains an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{R}^{2}$</tex> value of 0.983, with the MAPE significantly decreased to 2.85%. In addition, the RMSE and MAE are reduced to 2.94kW and 2.12kW, respectively, which are better than other models.

articleTitle: A Speed Estimation Method for Gear System Based on Cyclic and Vibration Spectrums
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Rotational speed is a critical parameter for the monitoring and fault diagnosis of industrial equipment. However, some industrial sites lack speed measurement devices, necessitating accurate speed estimation through vibration signals. The presence of low-frequency interference components and high-frequency aliasing sidebands in the complex vibration spectrum of the transmission system severely impacts the precision of speed frequency search. To address this issue, a method for estimating the rotational speed of gear transmission systems based on cyclic spectrum analysis of low-resolution vibration signals is proposed. By utilizing the cyclic spectrum to obtain a reference rotational frequency less susceptible to interference, and combining it with the equivalent velocity spectrum of vibration signals, the method effectively estimates the rotational components of the gear system. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through practical case studies.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Influence of Grid Characteristics of Low Voltage Circuit Breaker on Arc Extinguishing Process
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The characteristics of grid plates in low-voltage circuit breakers have significant implications for the evolution of the arc. Based on magnetohydrodynamics theory, a dynamic model of arc plasma is established using the COMSOL Multiphysics coupling platform to reveal the evolution patterns of the arc and analyze the mechanisms by which grid plate characteristics affect arc extinguishing under different conditions. The findings indicate that an increase in the effective length of the grid plates leads to a faster rate of change in arc pressure and a noticeable reduction in extinguishing time, with the number of grid plates significantly impacting the spatiotemporal behavior of the arc. Studying the characteristics of grid plates can provide a detailed scientific basis and reference for optimizing grid plate designs in circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Research on Electricity Theft Identification Method Based on Multi-Component Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The huge amount of electricity consumption data in the smart grid makes data-driven electricity theft detection possible, but extracting features from electricity consumption time series that can help electricity theft detection is a challenging problem. To address this problem, a power theft user identification method based on STL decomposition and feature fusion is proposed. Firstly, the original sequence is decomposed into trend, seasonal and residual components using a robust STL decomposition method; then, according to the characteristics of each component, the features of the trend and seasonal components are extracted using an LSTM neural network with an attentional mechanism (Att-LSTM) and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN), respectively; for the residual component, it is treated by a dynamics system analysis method is processed and the fractal dimension is calculated as its feature by GP algorithm; finally, the three component features are fused using a fully connected layer with attention mechanism for electricity theft user identification and compared with other methods. The results show that the feature extraction method used in this paper can effectively extract the features of electricity theft, and the method can accurately identify the electricity theft users.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Micro-Grid Group Sharing Energy Storage Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In order to avoid the problems of poor economic benefits and low utilization rate of renewable energy in multi-microgrid configuration of shared energy storage, an optimal scheduling method of microgrid cluster shared energy storage based on master-slave game theory is proposed. Firstly, the microgrid cluster system and the shared energy storage operator are systematically modeled. A master-slave game optimization model is constructed to share energy storage operators to provide energy storage leasing and participate in peak shaving of distribution network. Pursuing the maximum profit, adjusting the rental capacity according to the rental price to reduce its own electricity cost; finally, the energy storage leasing capacity and shared energy storage scheduling strategy in the microgrid are solved. The proposed method improves the profit of energy storage, improves the utilization efficiency of shared energy storage power station and microgrid cluster, and improves the economy of micro grid operation.

articleTitle: Detection of Known Signals Under Non-Gaussian Noise Based on the Laplacian Kernel
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a new robust detector employing the Laplacian kernel function to detect known signals in environments with impulsive noise. The effectiveness of the detector is assessed by comparing it to several widely used detectors. Monte Carlo simulations were also conducted to determine the optimal kernel width for specific noise conditions and to evaluate its asymptotic relative efficiency compared to the local optimum detector. The detector's excellent performance and its ability to function without prior knowledge of the noise enables it to be an alternative to current detection methods.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Scheduling Method for Multi-Type Resource Demand Response for Power Grid Regulation Demand
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of long solving time caused by the complexity of the optimization model in the optimal scheduling of distribution network, this paper proposes a multi-type resource demand response day-ahead scheduling method for grid regulation demand. Firstly, aiming at the difference of different types of resources participating in the reduction, a multi-type resource adjustable potential evaluation model was proposed. Secondly, a multi-type resource scheduling model was established. With the maximum total profit of the virtual power plant as the objective function, a user incentive cost model was formulated according to the principle that the electricity price was higher when the resource scheduling amount was closer to its upper limit. Then, the knapsack algorithm is used for optimization. The proposed method is tested in the example analysis. The solution results show that the knapsack algorithm can allocate various resources more effectively to meet the regulation needs of the power grid, and reduce the cost and shorten the solving time of the model.

articleTitle: Design of a Distributed Fiber Optic Online Temperature Measurement System for 10kV Intelligent Overhead Transformers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: When designing a distributed fiber optic online temperature measurement system for transformers, significant temperature measurement errors often occur, resulting in low temperature measurement accuracy. Therefore, a distributed fiber optic online temperature measurement system for 10kV intelligent overhead transformers is proposed. In terms of hardware design, temperature collectors and communicators were designed; In terms of software design, the temperature signal of the transformer collected by the temperature collector is first optimized and processed. By calculating the corresponding thermal time constant, its characteristics are analyzed. With the support of distributed fiber optic technology, a distributed fiber optic temperature measurement demodulation model for the transformer is constructed. The transformer temperature is quantified and calibrated to achieve temperature measurement for the transformer. In experimental testing, the designed 10kV intelligent overhead transformer distributed fiber optic online temperature measurement system has low linearity and high temperature measurement accuracy in practical applications.

articleTitle: Impact of Lightning Strike Waveform and Position on Transient Overvoltage in a 500 kV HVAC System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Lightning overvoltage is a major threat to the reliability of power supply in electrical systems. Standard lightning current impulses, such as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{8}/\mathbf{20}\boldsymbol{\mu}\mathbf{s}$</tex>, are typically used to analyze the system's overvoltage responses, for insulation coordination design of power systems. However, the waveforms of real lightning currents exhibit considerable randomness, resulting in variations of lightning overvoltage induced in the system. In this connection, this paper investigates the lightning overvoltage in a typical 500kV AC power system. By establishing a transient overvoltage simulation model, the transient lightning overvoltage in case of different lightning strike locations and waveforms are studied, the impacts of different factors on the intensity of lightning overvoltage under both shielding failure and back-flashover conditions are obtained. These conclusions are of great significance for elucidating the propagation mechanism of lightning overvoltage in power systems and improving the reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Two-Layer Optimal Scheduling Model of Zero-Carbon Park Based on Economy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Under the “dual carbon” goal, zero-carbon parks are of great significance to enhance the competitiveness of parks and protect the ecological balance. In this paper, we propose a bi-level optimal scheduling model focusing on flexible scheduling of high energy-consuming enterprises to achieve low-carbon transformation of industrial parks. The upper layer of the model considers the cost of carbon trading and green certificate trading, and the objective is to minimize the total operating cost; The lower layer is aimed at the workshop scheduling of high energy consuming enterprises, with the goal of reducing the maximum processing time and reducing costs. Through the coordination between the upper and lower levels, the park takes the cost savings of enterprises as subsidies and continuously optimizes the scheduling scheme. The feasibility and effectiveness of the model are verified by an example, and the results show that the method can reduce the cost of enterprises, improve the efficiency, help the load management of the park, and promote the realization of nearly zero carbon economic operation.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Missing Data Using Relevance Vector Regression
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a lifetime prediction method for electromechanical equipment, addressing the common problem of missing data during long-term operation. The method, based on the Relevance Vector Regression (RVR), involves three key processes: data normalization, RVR model development, and lifetime estimation by determining the first occurrence of a specified threshold. Missing data, often caused by sensor malfunctions or transmission issues, disrupts the reliability of operational analysis. To overcome it, the proposed RVR model employs a Gaussian kernel function to capture complex nonlinear relationships in the data and applies Bayesian inference to highlight critical data samples that influence predictions. This process effectively identifies hidden data correlations, enabling accurate lifetime estimation even under incomplete data conditions. In case study, trend data from a clinker cooler fan in cement production is analyzed. An incremental accuracy evaluation validates the model's prediction performance, achieving a 94% accuracy rate compared to actual lifetime data, despite data loss.

articleTitle: Design and Application of a Microwave-Based Sensor for Water Content in Crude Oil
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Based on the theoretical foundation of microwave time-domain transmission, a novel sensor for detecting water content in crude oil is designed. The principles of measuring the water content in oil-water mixtures using the sensor are introduced. The design includes the sensor's signal generation circuit, machine oscillation circuit, power splitter circuit, phase detector circuit, and liquid crystal display circuit. Finally, the measured data are corrected using the segmented linear interpolation method based on the calibrated water content values. The final water content error is less than 2%, achieving full-range detection of water content in crude oil.

articleTitle: Power Line Noise Acquisition and Analysis System for the 0-50MHz Frequency Band
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In this paper, a design scheme of power line noise acquisition and analysis equipment is proposed, which aims to effectively monitor and analyze noise data of power line noise, the hardware of the system mainly includes filter circuits, analog front-ends circuits, ADC sampling circuits, DAC circuits, digital processing circuits, etc., for the purpose of sampling high-frequency level data of power line noise. The system software processes this level data through steps such as decomposition and FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) conversion to analyze the power line noise signals. Then, by employing algorithm models, it quickly categorizes, displays, and plays back the noise frequency, intensity, and type of the interference. Thus, it provides a stable noise source for the design of power line communication systems' noise resistance performance and power consumption.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Primary Energy Price Fluctuation on Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Energy is an important means of production for industrial production and the foundation of economic and social development. This paper studies the price change relationship between energy sources, focusing on the impact of price fluctuations of oil, natural gas and coal on electricity prices. Using the VAR model, the data from 2001 to June 2024 in California, USA, is used to explore the transmission mechanism of primary energy fluctuations on electricity price changes, providing a reference for subsequent research and related policy decisions.

articleTitle: A Method for Extracting the Key Structural Parameters of Power Towers Oriented to Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This thesis presents an extraction method for the key structural parameters of power towers targeting point cloud data. From the point cloud data of power towers scanned by lidar, based on the symmetry of the tower structure and the variation in the axial point cloud distribution, the elevation plane of the tower and the hanging points of conductors and ground wires are identified. The structural parameters such as the elevation of the tower, the mid-distance of the hanging points of conductors and ground wires, and the height of the hanging points of conductors and ground wires are automatically extracted, providing an accurate data basis for the subsequent operation and maintenance of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research on Hierarchical Optimization of Intelligent Connected New Energy Vehicles Based on Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the intensification of the global energy crisis and environmental pollution, the research and development of intelligent connected new energy vehicles have become a hot topic. This study focuses on the hierarchical optimization control method of intelligent connected new energy vehicles, aiming to achieve efficient energy management and utilization through dynamic programming algorithms. The study first constructed the dynamic model and energy <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{flow}$</tex> model of intelligent connected new energy vehicles, providing a theoretical basis for hierarchical optimization control. Subsequently, dynamic programming algorithms were used to optimize the energy management strategy, and the Bellman principle of reverse optimization was employed to search for the global optimal solution, in order to achieve rational allocation and efficient utilization of energy. The simulation experiment results show that the hierarchical optimization control method based on dynamic programming can significantly improve the fuel economy and emission performance of intelligent connected new energy vehicles, providing strong support for the intelligent and efficient development of new energy vehicles. This study not only has important theoretical value, but also provides useful reference for the practical application and promotion of intelligent connected new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Text Extraction Algorithm for Metrological Experiment Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This power metering test detects various types of text data, with large variations in text length, which has a significant impact on the text detection model. Therefore, this article builds a deep learning model for power measurement experiment detection text based on DBNet, and uses MobilenetV3 feature extraction network, and adds residual links to PAN for feature enhancement. Finally, ASF is used for feature fusion, effectively solving the problem of detecting long texts in measurement experiment detection text data and achieving a high detection rate. The comparison of the final experimental results proves the superiority of this model.

articleTitle: Research on the Operation Optimization of Wind Storage Combined System Based on Compressed Air Energy Storage Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the expansion of the scale of renewable energy units connected to the power system, the problems of volatility and instability brought about by them are becoming more and more prominent. Compressed air energy storage technology has the advantages of high storage capacity, long life and small special investment, which is expected to become an effective means to promote the consumption of renewable energy and maintain the stability of the power grid. However, the current relationship between CAES and renewable energy capacity is not clear, which leads to its low economic efficiency and affects its promotion. In this paper, CAES technology is combined with wind power generation to construct a new joint system configuration scheme, constructs a physical structure model, and considers the equipment operation constraints, establishes a two-layer optimization model, with the upper layer taking the ROI as the objective, and the lower layer taking the volume of the storage tank as the objective, and solves the problem using the NSGA-II algorithm. The example results show that the two-layer optimization model is economical and can provide a reference for the operation decision of the wind storage system.

articleTitle: High-Precision Current Measurement Technology of Charging Pile Based on AC/DC Comparator and its Remote Calibration Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The introduction of the dual-carbon policy has accelerated the development of the electric vehicle industry and the improvement of technology. Among them, the improvement of charging infrastructure has always been a major issue in the industry. In this paper, a high-precision current measurement technology and its remote calibration method for charging piles based on Alternating Current/Direct Current (AC/DC) comparator are proposed. The technology uses precision current conversion standard, digital multimeter and high-precision current standard meter as measurement standards for measurement and calibration. Through supporting high-precision AC current standard meter, digital oscilloscope, DC current ripple tester and other auxiliary equipment, the calibration of three parameters of DC current standard source current indication error, short-term stability and ripple content is realized. This remote calibration method can not only greatly reduce the cost, improve the efficiency of metrological verification, but also effectively improve the accuracy and reliability of metrological verification. Through this technology, the electric energy metering device of the charging pile can realize real-time and accurate electric energy calibration without interrupting the normal operation, which provides a strong guarantee for the measurement accuracy of the electric vehicle charging pile.

articleTitle: A Network with Feature Partition and Local Feature Embedded for Vehicle Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Vehicle re-identification is a sophisticated computer vision task. The existing methods mainly focus on global feature processing, which find it difficult to address the inter-class similarity and the intra-class difference. This paper proposed a network with detail-oriented ability and contextual information reunion, which integrated global features, local features and partition features into a unified framework for exploring more details to re-identify the vehicles. The network utilized a local branch with the local self-attention module (LSA) to explore the details within the marked regions, which can identify and distinguish the subtle differences from the local regions of different vehicles. Also, the network used the partition branch to explore the common contextual information between different parts for clustering images of vehicles with the same id. The experiments on VeRi776 datasets verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Impedance Modeling Method Considering the Phase of the Grid Connection Point in Grid-Forming and Grid-Following Converter Multi-Machine System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid growth of renewable energy sources such as wind and solar power has contributed to environmental improvements while introducing new challenges to the safe and stable operation of power systems. Impedance-based methods are widely used for small-signal stability analysis; however, conventional modeling approaches that neglect the grid connection point phase are increasingly inadequate as research on inverters advances. This paper presents a novel modeling method that accounts for the phase of the grid connection point. By incorporating the grid connection phase in the derivation process, the proposed approach ensures applicability even when the inverter phase is not constant. The method is applied to the grid-forming and grid-following converter multi-machine systems to investigate factors influencing its stability, thereby demonstrating the method's versatility and general applicability.

articleTitle: A Multitask Genetic Programming Approach with ANew Individual Representation to Symbolic Regression
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Symbolic regression is a task aimed at auto-matically discovering and constructing mathematical models from data that describe the complex relationships between inputs and outputs. Evolutionary multitask methods have demonstrated powerful capabilities across various domains, but research in the field of symbolic regression remains relatively limited. To further explore the potential of evo-lutionary multi task algorithms in symbolic regression, this paper proposes a multitask Genetic Programming (GP) approach with a new individual representation (IRMTGP), which encodes shared knowledge as a shared tree, explicitly facilitating knowledge transfer between tasks. Specifically, in IRMTGP, each task's solution is composed of a shared tree and an unshared tree, where the shared tree captures common knowledge across tasks, and the unshared tree focuses on learning the characteristics of individual tasks.
