Furthermore, to learn the optimal shared and unshared trees, a new fitness function and evolutionary process are designed. Comparing IRMTGP with GP and Multifactorial GP on six multi task problems composed of four symbolic regression benchmarks, IRMTGP achieves smaller regression errors and better generalization capabilities in most cases.

articleTitle: Deep Semantic Graph Learning via Large Language Models-Based Node Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Graph learning has attracted significant attention due to its widespread real-world applications. Current mainstream approaches rely on text node features and obtain initial node embeddings through shallow embedding learning using GNNs, which shows limitations in capturing deep textual semantics. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated superior capabilities in understanding text semantics, transforming traditional text feature processing. This paper proposes a novel framework that combines Graph Transformer architecture with LLM-enhanced node features. Specifically, we leverage LLMs to generate rich semantic representations of text nodes, which are then processed by a multihead self-attention mechanism in the Graph Transformer to capture both local and global graph structural information. Our model utilizes the Transformer's attention mechanism to dynamically aggregate neighborhood information while preserving the semantic richness provided by LLM embeddings. Experimental results demonstrate that the LLM-enhanced node features significantly improve the performance of graph learning models on node classification tasks. This approach shows promising results across multiple graph learning tasks, offering a practical direction for combining graph networks with language models.

articleTitle: Distribution Circuit Load Forecasting and Warning System Based on Prophet
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In order to ensure the stable operation of the power grid, alleviate the work pressure of business personnel, and solve the problems of low accuracy and timeliness of manual prediction/warning, a distribution circuit load prediction and heavy overload warning system based on the Prophet method was designed after comprehensively considering the actual needs of business personnel and the characteristics of transformer load data. Based on the time series characteristics of distribution circuit load data, Prophet's time series decomposition and machine learning techniques are used to model the data, predict the load status of the power system in the future, display the real-time operation status of each circuit, issue warnings for potential heavy overload risks, and automatically handle missing/abnormal values in the data. The warning system designed in this paper was tested based on multiple indicators such as processing speed, root mean square error (RMSE), and correct warning rate, and the results showed that the system has high practicality.

articleTitle: Vehicle Electromagnetic Compatibility Test Business Management System Based on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In this paper, the vehicle electromagnetic compatibility test business management system based on the big data platform realizes the standardized management of the vehicle electromagnetic compatibility test business process and the automatic generation of standard test reports. The system uses java language to realize the functions of order establishment, sample storage, automatic distribution of detection tasks, and upload of detection data on the Springboot framework. Using Apache POI technology, after establishing the report template, the standard test report can be automatically generated according to the uploaded data. After verification by the test personnel, the system greatly reduces the time to issue test data and test reports, reduces repeatability and error rate, and improves work efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-Device Data Fusion IoT Monitoring System for Home Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the development of technology and the increasing demand for quality of life, home security has become one of the evaluation standards for modern quality of life. This paper proposes a smart home Internet of Things (IoT) monitoring system aimed at enhancing home security. Through real-time detection and automatic response capabilities for fires, gas leaks, and water and electricity usage, the system provides comprehensive security protection for families. The system integrates various sensors and smart home appliances, achieving real-time monitoring and prevention of potential security risks through multi-device data fusion. The system design employs data fusion algorithms capable of timely identification of potential hazards and coordination of device responses, thereby effectively preventing the occurrence of safety incidents.

articleTitle: DC Microgrid Arc Fault Diagnosis Based on Feature Frequency Extraction and Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To address the challenge of series arc fault detection in DC microgrid systems, this research proposes an arc fault diagnosis approach based on feature frequency extraction and kernel extreme learning machine (KELM). The arc fault characteristic frequency is chosen by means of the signal's variational mode decomposition (VMD) and Hilbert marginal spectrum (HMS) analysis. The singular value, sample entropy, and energy entropy of the modal component that corresponds to the eigenfrequency are computed in order to generate the eigenvector. Subsequently, the KELM is utilized for arc fault diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively extracts fault characteristics, achieving a recognition accuracy of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">98.26%</sup> in arc fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Tobacco Foreign Object Detection Method Based on Intermediate Feature Layer Distillation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Foreign object detection in tobacco production is critical. To address the challenge of balancing high detection accuracy and real-time performance, this study proposes an object detection framework based on intermediate feature layer distillation to enhance model performance. Through attention-guided distillation and non-local distillation, the intermediate layer knowledge of the teacher model is transferred to the student model, thereby improving its accuracy in detecting non-tobacco foreign objects in tobacco production. Experimental results on the tobacco foreign object dataset show that, compared to direct training, the proposed method improves the mAP of the PAA50 model by 2.5% and the AR by 1%. The feature-based knowledge distillation method proposed in this study effectively improves the performance of tobacco foreign object detection models, thereby enabling the efficient detection of non-tobacco foreign objects in tobacco production.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Zoning Planning Method Based on Community Discovery Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In order to solve the current grid division method's ability to cope with faults and lack of flexibility, the division method is studied. Firstly, the target network structure is optimized and the community discovery partition is used to partition the distribution network. The network simplification method and solution algorithm are studied. Secondly, the network is further divided by using the regional capacity load ratio. On this basis, according to the simulation of the fault, the reliability of the division results is verified, and the feasibility of the partition method is verified. It provides the possibility for the economy of urban distribution network transformation and improves the ability and flexibility of distribution network to cope with faults.

articleTitle: A Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-Based Social-Aware Cooperative Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Computation offloading primarily addresses the deficiencies of user devices in terms of resource storage, computational performance, and energy efficiency in Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) networks. However, the dynamic network topology, limited resources of devices, and diversity of user requirements in Internet of Things (IoT) pose significant challenges in achieving efficient computational offloading. In this paper, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based social-aware cooperative task offloading scheme (DSCTO) is proposed to minimize the system cost, in which the clustering algorithm based on the social relationship is first designed to shrink the decision space of DRL. Then, the DRL is used to make offloading decisions in terms of the offloading devices and offloading rate. Simulation results demonstrate that the performance of the proposed DSCTO outperforms other concerned schemes.

articleTitle: Transformer Winding Vibration Prediction Based on VMD- DTW - Informer
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The winding, as a part with frequent faults in power transformers, is an important basis for analyzing its health state. In order to reveal the trend of winding vibration in operation transformers, this paper proposes a winding vibration prediction method based on variational mode decomposition-dynamic time warping (VMD-DTW)-Informer. Firstly, according to the principle of winding vibration generation in transformers, an extraction method of surface vibration features of transformers based on VMD-DTW is designed. Secondly, considering the intrinsic relationship between the operating conditions of transformers and the winding vibration, an Informer transformer winding prediction model is established, and the winding vibration prediction in operation transformers is completed. The experimental results show that the winding vibration extraction method based on VMD-DTW can effectively extract the vibration features of transformer windings, and the Informer transformer winding prediction model considering the operating conditions of transformers can significantly improve the accuracy of vibration prediction, which can provide important reference for the in-operation winding state monitoring technology.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Trajectory Planning Framework Based on 3D Spatiotemporal Coupling
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Trajectory planning is critical in autonomous driving systems, as it generates feasible driving paths in dynamic 3D spatiotemporal environments. This paper presents a hierarchical traj ectory planning framework based on 3D spatiotemporal coupling to improve algorithm efficiency and adaptability across various environments. The framework first employs a kinematic model-based sampling method and heuristic search to compute a reference traj ectory that ensures safety and considers vehicle motion coordination, providing strong adaptability to dynamic obstacles. Key trajectory points are then selected for optimization through variable-step sampling, reducing the problem's dimensionality. Kinematic, obstacle, and control constraints are incorporated to enhance trajectory safety and smoothness. Extensive simulations across different scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms traditional approaches, offering superior robustness, real-time performance, and adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Vehicle Trajectory Planning Based on Improved RRT-APF Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Multi-intelligent vehicle system can meet the needs of various missions. Efficient collaborative planning method is the key to improve its performance. In this paper, the trajectory planning of multi-vehicle system are studied. Firstly, the RRT algorithm which introduced pruning optimization and local replanning was used to plan the global path of each vehicle as the guide of trajectory planning. Then, deductive planning method and asymmetric potential field force are proposed to improve the artificial potential field method, and multi-vehicle sequence planning and collaborative planning are realized. This paper conducted simulation experiments to verify the effectiveness of the method. The experiments proved that the sequence planning method and collaborative planning method both can complete planning tasks under simple working conditions, and the collaborative planning method has higher efficiency under complex working conditions.

articleTitle: Verification and Testing of Emergency Stability Control for Micro-Grid in Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the development and transformation of industrial micro-grid, analyzing the emergency stability control of micro-grid when a fault occurs and the section is disconnected is of significant importance. In this paper, the industrial power grid characteristics are analyzed and the mathematical model of comprehensive loads are established. An emergency stability controller with voltage control and frequency control functions is proposed and the block of controller is designed by the programming language DSL. A micro-grid in industrial park based on RTDS is used for semi physical simulation testing of emergency stability control strategy. Simulation of under-frequency reverse power show that the correctness and effectiveness of the emergency stability control strategy.

articleTitle: Pseudo-Measurement Generation Method Based on GCN-Transformer for Lightweight Measurement Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of distributed generation, the scale and complexity of distribution networks are constantly increasing, making it essential to enhance the real-time situational awareness of distribution networks. In response to the current issues of insufficient real-time measurement data in distribution networks, this paper proposes a pseudo-measurement generation method that combines Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) and Transformer. The GCN-Transformer takes network topology information and real-time measurements from buses as the input to generate high-precision pseudo-measurement data, further achieving system observability. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified through simulation based on the IEEE 33-bus system.

articleTitle: The Intrusion Detection Method for Power Grid Industrial Control Systems Based on Improved Triplet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, particularly deep learning, intrusion detection methods based on deep learning have gained significant attention. Deep learning can automatically extract features from large datasets and classify complex patterns, offering better adaptability and flexibility than traditional methods. It is especially effective in handling dynamic industrial environments and unknown attacks, improving detection accuracy while reducing false positives and false negatives. However, challenges remain, such as model generalization and computational efficiency. To address these, this paper proposes an improved triplet neural network-based intrusion detection method for industrial control systems (ICS). The system includes modules for data collection, preprocessing, model construction, training, and real-time detection. By incorporating a self-attention mechanism, the improved model better recognizes complex attack patterns and adapts to new threats. Experimental results show an accuracy of 98.7%, with a significant reduction in false positives and false negatives, enhancing ICS security and providing a new approach for handling future cyberattacks.

articleTitle: Multi-Timescale Loss Reduction Optimization Study of Distribution Network Considering Flexible Charging of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of uncertainty of wind and photovoltaic power output and disorderly charging of a large number of electric vehicles accessing the distribution network leading to the superposition of distribution network load peaks and the increase of network loss, a multi-timescale loss-reduction operation strategy of the distribution network considering electric vehicles is proposed. The probability distribution of EV behavior is established, and the EV charging output model conforming to the user's travel habit is built using the Latin hypercubic sampling method. Considering the influence of the deviation of the wind and photovoltaic output forecasts on different time scales, a multi-timescale optimal dispatch strategy based on the day-ahead-intraday is established, and a mathematical model is constructed by introducing the dynamic time-of-day tariff and using the network loss and the operating cost as the objective function. Different scenarios are simulated in the improved IEEE 33-bus system, and the comparative results show that the proposed optimization strategy is effective in reducing losses and smoothing load fluctuations, and the flexibility of EVs participating in the demand response of the grid reduces the impact of the wind and photovoltaic power integration while compensating for the deviation of the forecast of the wind and photovoltaic power outputs, thus maintaining the system balance.

Author Keywords: loss reduction optimization on multiple time scales

articleTitle: Integral Robust Strategy for Pressure Control of Electro-Hydraulic Proportional Servo Valves
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Electro-hydraulic proportional servo valves are widely used in pressure control loops of electro-hydraulic servo systems due to their low manufacturing cost and strong contamination resistance. In such systems, the traditional PID control method often struggles to meet the demands of high-precision pressure control due to issues such as parameter uncertainty, nonlinearity, and external disturbances. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a pressure control strategy for electro-hydraulic proportional servo valves based on the Robust Integral of the Sign Error control algorithm. This approach successfully achieves high-precision pressure control in electro-hydraulic servo systems. Simulation experiments were conducted to compare the performance of the proposed strategy. The results demonstrate that the proposed control method significantly improves system response speed and reduces steady-state pressure oscillations, providing valuable insights for related engineering applications.

Author Keywords: Robust Integral of the Sign Error control

articleTitle: Research on Student Behavior Recognition Based on Improved YOLOV8
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This study utilizes Labelme software to annotate 1500 student behavior images, constructing a dataset that includes key student behaviors such as Think, Write, Mobile, Pass notes, Glance, and Talk. To enhance the diversity and coverage of the dataset, traditional digital image processing techniques, including image flipping, rotation, brightness adjustment, and the addition of Gaussian noise, were employed to expand the initial dataset, resulting in a small dataset of 2000 images. In terms of model training, this paper embeds the CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) attention mechanism into the YOLOV8 network structure to improve the accuracy of behavior recognition. After 100 rounds of training, the average mAP0.5 (mean Average Precision) for all behavior categories reached 63.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which is an approximately 7% increase in recognition accuracy compared to the original YOLOV8 model.

articleTitle: Applications of Physics-Informed Neural Networks in High-Voltage Insulation Engineering: A Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In High-Voltage Engineering (HVE), electrical insulation systems are essential to power assets. The rational design and preventative maintenance of insulation systems are two main research directions for power assets. In essence, the research of two directions is on exploring and representing high-voltage physics properties for insulation systems, such as space charge phenomena, electric field distribution, discharge and breakdown, and much more. Hence, a series of physical models and partial differential equations (PDEs) have been widely developed to characterize and describe these physical phenomena. Nevertheless, the parameters of these models are often difficult to solve and highly dependent on the numerical calculation techniques. Besides, deep learning as a pure data-driven technique also is used to conduct the insulation state inversion of power assets, but a large amount of high-quality training data is needed. Fortunately, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) incorporate the dual advantages of physical models and a data-driven approach, which could be a promising solution. Driven by this fact, this work summarizes the recent research progress of PINN applications in three types of insulation systems (gas, solid, and liquid). Meanwhile, the challenges and outlook are discussed, offering inspiration for further development of PINNs in HVE.

articleTitle: Optimization and Scheduling of VPP Under the Electricity Market Mechanism Considering Carbon Emission Costs
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the increasingly prominent energy and environmental problems, distributed energy has been widely used. However, these energy sources also have problems such as high investment costs and instability in the power grid. To address this problem, the concept of virtual power plants (VPPs) has been proposed, which can effectively aggregate widely distributed uncontrollable clean energy sources and improve the stability and efficiency of energy supply. This paper proposes an optimal scheduling method for VPPs considering environmental costs and system operating benefits to achieve optimal operation of the system. Firstly, a scheduling model for VPPs is constructed with the optimization objectives of maximizing system operating benefits and minimizing environmental costs; Considering that the disadvantage of the differential evolution (DE) algorithm lies in the storage problem, and the disadvantage of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) lies in sacrificing the diversity problem among populations, combining DE and PSO to improve their respective shortcomings; Finally, the design case considers three objectives to optimize the output of each energy unit. The simulation results show that the energy output of controllable energy sources will be further controlled after considering environmental costs, thereby reducing environmental costs. In addition, the feasibility and correctness of applying the hybrid algorithm to VPP scheduling are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Multi-Cluster Hierarchical Control Strategy Considering Voltage Quality of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of node voltage over-limit and parameter variable increase caused by the high proportion of distributed photovoltaic (PV) access to the distribution network (DN), this paper proposes a distributed PV multi-cluster hierarchical control strategy that considers the voltage quality of the DN. Firstly, the composition of distributed PV multi-cluster hierarchical control architecture and the functions of each part are introduced. Secondly, an inter-group collaborative optimization strategy with the control objectives of minimizing the voltage deviation of the PV cluster leading node and the system network loss is proposed, and an intra-group autonomous optimization strategy is proposed. Then, the multi-objective quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the established PV multi-cluster hierarchical control model. Finally, the simulation results in the improved IEEE 33-bus example show that the proposed inter-group coordination and intra-group autonomous control strategy can effectively reduce the system node voltage deviation, improve the power quality, and ensure the safe and economic operation of the DN in multiple scenarios.

articleTitle: Online Recognition of Defects and Foreign Objects Based on Wavelet Scattering Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: During the inspection of transmission lines by unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), the captured images are typically transmitted to the cloud for processing, and currently, online detection cannot be performed locally on the UAV. This paper proposes a lightweight model based on an improved wavelet scattering convolutional network that enables local online identification of defects and foreign objects on edge devices. This lightweight model comprises an improved wavelet scattering network and a small convolutional neural network (CNN). The improved wavelet scattering network is more flexible than the classical network and can effectively extract the key features of the picture; The small CNN is divided into two parts: a four-layer convolutional network section for further extraction of small target features, and a three-layer fully connected for feature recognition and classification. Experimental results demonstrate that this lightweight model exhibits strong generalization and real-time performance, with accuracy rates for defect and foreign object identification exceeding 90%. The recognition speed is three times faster than that of YOLOv5s and nearly four times faster than YOLOv8s. The recognition speed on various edge devices exceeds 30 frames per second (FPS), meeting the 30FPS of UAV-captured videos, and reaching up to 153.8 FPS on Orange Pi 5B, enabling local online detection frame by frame.

articleTitle: Research on Bidding and Tendering Risk Warning Algorithms Based on Knowledge Graph Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the standardization of tendering and bidding supervision and the development of artificial intelligence technology, illegal and disciplinary acts in tendering and bidding have been limitedly controlled. This paper, in combination with the current development of knowledge graph technology and the security early warning requirements faced by tendering and bidding, proposes a tendering and bidding risk early warning model based on knowledge graph, realizes the automatic extraction of tendering and bidding data knowledge and the construction of the graph. And based on the word embedding model (Word2Vec), sentiment analysis model and risk integral model, it realizes the risk assessment of tendering and bidding projects, helps the regulatory authorities to identify and clear risky projects. Verified by experiments, this model can limitedly realize the risk discrimination of tendering projects and effectively improve the working efficiency of the regulatory authorities.

articleTitle: Research on a High-Reliability and Low-Loss Power-Saving Fast Switching Device Based on Fast Mechanical Switch Combination of Eddy Current Repulsion Operating Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the increasing sensitive load in modern power grid, voltage sag and interruption of several cycles will lead to equipment tripping, resulting in serious economic losses. Voltage sag and short-term interruption are important problems that must be solved in the development of modern industry. At present, the common mechanical switching dual-power switching device (ATS) has slow switching speed and is not suitable for voltage-sensitive loads, while the solid-state switching dual-power switching device (STS) has poor current capacity and anti-interference ability and high loss, so it is difficult to popularize. In view of the problems and shortcomings of the existing devices, this paper develops a high-reliability and low-loss power-saving fast switching device based on the rapid mechanical switch combination of eddy current repulsion operating mechanism, which can realize the fast and reliable switching of dual-channel power supply within 20ms, provide high-quality power support for sensitive loads, and ensure the safe and reliable power consumption of sensitive and important loads.

articleTitle: Enhancing Multi-Object Tracking Using Roadside Camera Based on Trajectory Prediction in BEV
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the continuous development of vehicle-infrastructure collaborative autonomous driving, the importance of roadside tracking is becoming increasingly prominent. However, tracking on the image plane is difficult to solve the occlusion problem in roadside environments. Therefore, a camera multi-object tracking method based on BEV plane trajectory prediction enhancement is proposed. Specifically, the paper adopts geometric methods for depth estimation to improve the generalization of roadside camera tracking, and effectively solves the occlusion problem through trajectory prediction in the BEV plane. We conducted tests on the CROP dataset and the experiments showed that our method is effective, with an average improvement of 4.04 on the MOTA metric.

articleTitle: Research on Object Detection of Suspension Clamps Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of partially obscuring the target features of the overhanging wire clip detection and being susceptible to environmental interference in the high altitude, a transmission line overhanging wire clip detection network based on YOLOv8 is proposed. In order to adapt to the requirements of the deployment of small embedded devices for UAVs, the C2f module in the Neck layer is improved to a lightweight C2f RVBCA module to reduce the model size and increase the operation rate. The proposed network is compared with other mainstream YOLO series target detection algorithms by constructing and expanding the data set for training, and the results show that the proposed network performs better in detecting the overhanging wire clips on transmission lines. Compared with the benchmark model, the number of model parameters and computational effort of our model are reduced by 15.6% and 16.9%, respectively, and the mAP50 is improved by 2 percentage points on the homemade dataset, and our model outperforms the benchmark model in tests in multiple environments.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Comprehensive Energy Grid Consumption Capacity Under Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The real-time operational status information redundancy of the integrated energy system leads to significant deviations between the relevant characteristics of the integrated power grid and the electricity consumption characteristics of the user side, which affects the health of the integrated energy grid. To address this, a comprehensive energy grid electricity capacity optimization model under health monitoring is proposed. By determining the energy consumption optimization indicators, the K-means clustering algorithm is applied to find the sample day with the highest similarity to the optimal consumption day. Introducing a fusion factor and combining it with the SVR model to optimize the electricity consumption capacity and achieve the optimization of the comprehensive electricity consumption capacity of the power grid. The experimental results show that this research method can monitor the unbalanced current of integrated energy grid equipment, accurately monitor the health status of integrated energy network equipment, and increase the consumption rate to 93%.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing Method of Electric Vehicle Charging Pile Optimization Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid expansion of electric vehicles, charging service market also rapid development, the construction of charging station operation will be dominated by the government gradually to various social capital in investment construction, different charging stations belonging to different charging station operators, in order to maximize their own interests, a competitive relationship between the charging stations. In order to solve the problem of multi-subject interest balance in the charging market scenario composed of multiple charging stations and multiple electric vehicle (EV) travelers, it is necessary to study the charging price pricing method of calculating the interest game of charging stations. Therefore, this paper proposes the EV charging pile pricing method optimized based on the particle swarm algorithm to solve the problem that the charging price pricing method cannot take into account the multi-party interests of charging stations and EV travelers.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization Strategy of Microgrid Based on Cooperative Operation of Optical Storage in Industrial Park
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the continuous development of photovoltaic power generation and energy storage technology, microgrid systems in industrial parks have gradually become an important means to achieve efficient use of green energy. Aiming at the energy demand of industrial parks, this paper proposes a multi-objective optimization strategy based on the cooperative operation of photovoltaic power generation and energy storage. By analyzing the fluctuation of photovoltaic power generation and the charge-discharge characteristics of the energy storage system, a multi-objective optimization model which can achieve energy balance and maximize economic benefits under different working conditions is constructed. Optimization objectives cover many aspects such as maximizing photovoltaic utilization, minimizing energy storage costs, matching load demand and reducing environmental pollution. In order to solve the multi-objective optimization problem, the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) was used to solve the optimization model, and the actual data of the industrial park was simulated and verified. The results show that the optimization strategy can effectively improve the photovoltaic consumption rate, reduce the operating cost of the system, and ensure the stable operation of important loads, which provides a new technical solution for energy management in industrial parks.

articleTitle: Bi-directional Power Flow Simulation of Permanent Magnet Linear Machine for Gravity Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Solid gravity energy storage (GES) can realize the bi-directional power flow according to grid dispatching by using permanent magnet linear machine (PMLM). When the power of grid is excessive, electricity can be inputted to lift a heavy block to a certain height to store the gravitational potential energy of this heavy block. On the contrast, when the power of grid is shortage, the heavy block is lowered and the stored gravitational potential energy can be converted into electrical energy through the generator mode by controlling PMLM. According to this direct driven type with PMLM, the GES has higher energy conversion efficiency compared with the traditional GES type. This paper uses the principle of GES to design a PMLM structure for motor/generation operation, establishes a dynamic mathematical model of PMLM, and proposes a three-loop control system of power, speed, and current as the main control part of the entire GES system. The bi-directional power flow operation characteristics of the proposed PMLM is simulated by using Matlab/Simulink to implement the GES study in the future.

articleTitle: Dynamic Torque Correction Method for High-Power Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Temperature Compensation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To solve the problem of difficulty in dealing with motor parameter saturation and permanent magnet temperature changes when using strategies such as maximum torque current ratio to optimize motor operating efficiency in high-power construction machinery permanent magnet synchronous motor drive systems, a temperature compensation based dynamic torque correction method for high-power permanent magnet synchronous motors is proposed. Firstly, based on the calibration lookup table, establish a motor flux compensation model that considers inductive coupling. Then, based on the long short-term memory network, a correlation model between the deviation of torque factors and torque deviation is established, and the torque reference value is corrected to obtain the torque value under real-time operation. According to the new torque command, the current lookup table is updated to update the direct and quadrature axis currents. Finally, it was confirmed through experiments that the proposed method enables permanent magnet synchronous motors to achieve better electromagnetic torque accuracy over a wide temperature range.

articleTitle: Adaptive Embedding Using Contrastive Learning with Median Absolute Deviation and Variance for Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Recommendation systems have increasingly relied on embedding techniques to capture user preferences and item features. Adaptive temperature techniques have rapidly developed to provide more accurate recommendations. However, these methods often struggle with popularity bias and a lack of adaptability in dynamic environments, which will end in a decline of the robustness and the bias in temperature prediction. To address these challenges, we propose integrating noise-based data augmentation and InfoNCE loss from the XSimGCL framework into the adaptively modulating embedding magnitude model. Our method enhances traditional adaptive temperature adjustment by incorporating statistical measures like median absolute deviation and variance of embedding norms, aiming to create more robust and adaptive embeddings. This approach eliminates the necessity for adapting temperature by loss, instead focusing on incorporating statistical measures and adding noise to enhance robustness. Extensive evaluations on several real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates popularity bias and significantly improves overall recommendation quality. This suggests that the nuanced integration of contrastive learning with adaptive embedding techniques can lead to more personalized and equitable recommendations.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Train Control Center Simulation System Based on CPN
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Train Control Center (TCC) is the hub of the information interaction of the column control system. It is the core system that ensures the safety of railway driving and ensure transportation efficiency. The traditional manual test method has many problems, such as high test cost, long time-consuming and low efficiency, and great influence of human subjective factors. This paper uses computer simulation technology to build a simulation test system. By analyzing the information interaction between the column control center and other devices, the computer simulation technology is used to build the simulation test system simulation control system operation. This system can intuitively reflect the performance of the column control system, which is convenient to optimize and adjust the design scheme, make theoretical guidance for the establishment of the real control system. According to the functional test requirements of TCC, this paper uses Colored Petri Net (CPN) to establish a hierarchical model for the simulation test system of the train control center. Taking the temporary speed limit scene test as an example, the formal modeling of the simulation test system through CPN can avoid the ambiguity caused by the specification description, improve the timeliness and safety of the system, help to find the problems that may occur in the design specification, manufacturing and operation of the system, and provide some reference for the design of the real train control system.

articleTitle: A U-Net-Based Approach for Fundus Retinal Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of fundus retinal image segmentation is investigated. The U-Net which is based on convolutional neural networks is used to explore the fundus retinal image segmentation. The U -Net structure includes a contraction path and an expansion path, and the U-Net can effectively combine the context information and position information of an image to achieve accurate segmentation. The data augmentation techniques including gray scale conversion, standardization, histogram equalization, and gamma transformation are employed to preprocess images to enhance the image features and improve the segmentation accuracy. The experimental results on the DRIVE dataset show that the proposed U-Net-based approach achieves excellent segmentation performance with an accuracy of as high as 95.6%.

articleTitle: Smooth Particle Swarm Fluid Simulation Algorithm Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH), as a fluid simulation technique, has significant advantages in dealing with complex boundary and large deformation simulation problems, and has been widely applied in the fields of film and television animation special effects, virtual reality, metaverse, and digital twins. However, traditional methods combining SPH with neural networks have limitations in capturing local area details. To address these issues, this paper proposes an improved model - Adaptive Search Smoothed Particle Network (ASSPN). ASSPN integrates deep learning technology, optimizes the neural network structure, and enhances computational accuracy and detail simulation accuracy. Compared to traditional SPH and Neural Particle Method (NPM), ASSPN demonstrates higher robustness in handling boundary conditions and complex application scenarios, offering greater spatial discretization flexibility in the field of fluid simulation, and is expected to become a powerful tool for fluid dynamics modeling.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Ultrasound for Damage Detection and Localization in Aluminum Alloy Thin Plates
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming at the damage characteristics of aluminum alloy thin plate which is prone to cracks and holes during service, this study proposes a localization method based on the relationship between the nonlinear ultrasonic coefficient and the ultrasonic propagation distance as well as the ultrasonic propagation path offset damage distance. First, the selection of ultrasonic frequency and nonlinear ultrasonic coefficient are determined according to the propagation characteristics of Lamb waves. Secondly, the relationship between the nonlinear ultrasonic coefficient and the ultrasonic propagation distance as well as the damage distance offset from the ultrasonic propagation path is analyzed through the finite element model, and the precise positioning of the damage location is realized by analyzing the change of the nonlinear ultrasonic coefficient. Finally, the method is experimentally verified in aluminum alloy thin plate, and the experimental results show that the method can accurately identify the damage in aluminum alloy thin plate and locate it precisely, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy System Scheduling Based on Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The utilisation of distributed energy resources (DERs) can improve energy efficiency. However, due to the uncertainty and system complexity of renewable energy sources, there are difficulties in energy scheduling for DERs systems. Current scheduling algorithms based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have the advantages of real-time learning and dynamic environment adaptation, but still have some problems, such as the difficulty of strictly satisfying the balance between supply and demand. In addition, it is difficult to establish an accurate environment model for DERs, which leads to insufficient training of DRL algorithms, which may not be able to make safe decisions in the face of unknown situations. To address these issues, this paper proposes an approach that uses a pre-trained neural network to learn the sensitivity of energy system supply and demand constraints, builds a security layer in combination with a security adjustment policy, and integrates it into a deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm to enhance the security of the policy network. Experimental results show that this approach can monitor and dynamically adjust the power in real time to effectively reduce the security risk.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Efficiency Improvement Strategy of Air Conditioning in Comprehensive Energy System Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To enhance the precision of the integrated energy system's operational approach, the study suggests utilizing a BP neural network for forecasting thermal and cooling demands, thereby minimizing forecast inaccuracies. This paper develops models for ice storage, gas boilers, and ground source heat pump cooling and heating equipment outputs. To enhance system efficiency, an energy efficiency target function is established. Simulation analysis shows that the BP neural network reduces prediction errors more effectively than exponential smoothing and gray prediction methods. The optimized operation model for the integrated energy system boosts the air conditioning system's comprehensive energy efficiency from 3.2 to 3.7.

articleTitle: Research on High Efficiency Linear Power Supply with Fixed Collector Emitter Voltage Suitable for Magnetically Controlled Resonant Transformers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Aiming to address the problem that the most frequently used input power supplies cannot meet the requirements of high-voltage test, a high efficiency linear power supply with fixed collector emitter voltage is proposed in this article. Firstly, the basic topology, working principle, and control strategy of the power supply are introduced, and the theoretical working efficiency of the device is derived. Secondly, the MATLAB simulation model is built to preliminarily analyze the characteristics of the power supply under steady-state and dynamic conditions. Finally, a simulation platform for the magnetically controlled resonant high-voltage test system based on the novel linear power supply is built according to theoretical deduction. The simulation results indicate that not only does the aberration rate of the output voltage of the power supply is low, but the actual working efficiency of the designed device is also higher than that of conventional power supplies, which can meet the requirements of the magnetically controlled resonant high-voltage test system.

Author Keywords: magnetically controlled resonant high-voltage test system

articleTitle: Research on Circuit Architecture of SAR ADC
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In the information age, a large number of signals are processed digitally through digital signals, but the physical quantities in the real world are almost continuous. Therefore, when continuous physical quantities are converted into electrical signals through sensors, the obtained signals are continuous electrical signals (analog signals), and a conversion device is needed to convert the electrical signals into digital signals that can be processed. This device is the analog-to-digital converter (ADC), which is known as the bridge connecting the physical world and the digital world. For ADCs, the conversion rate and conversion accuracy are two main indicators. At the same time, it is extremely difficult to design an ADC with both high conversion rate and high accuracy, and there is still a big gap between China and foreign countries in the design of ultra-high-performance ADCs. With the rapid development of China's electronic industry in recent years, the demand for high-precision and high-speed ADCs in electronic design is increasing. Therefore, the design of high-performance ADCs has always been the focus of domestic research. At the same time, with the increasing attention paid to the semiconductor industry in China in recent years, domestic scholars and research institutions have done a lot of research and experiments on improving the performance by adopting different architectures of ADCs. The mainstream ADC architectures include pipeline ADC, SAR ADC, Delta Sigma ADC, etc. Different structures have different advantages in terms of power consumption, conversion rate, and conversion accuracy. Next, a brief introduction to these ADCs will be given.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Consumption and Carbon Emission Prediction for Enterprises in Dongguan Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the intensification of global climate change, the management of energy consumption and carbon emissions by enterprises has become increasingly crucial. As a major manufacturing center in China, Dongguan faces significant pressures on energy and carbon emissions in its economic development. This study develops a machine learning model combining random forest regression and polynomial regression to accurately predict carbon emissions of enterprises in Dongguan. The model leverages the capability of random forest regression to effectively capture nonlinear relationships, while polynomial regression enhances trend validation, resulting in an overall prediction accuracy exceeding 92% for enterprise carbon emissions. Through this model, we have provided an in-depth analysis of the coupling relationship between electricity consumption and carbon emissions, offering a scientific basis for enterprises to develop effective carbon reduction strategies and promoting sustainable development.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Energy Optimization for Photovoltaic Storage Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The large-scale integration of electric vehicles presents considerable challenges to power grid stability and security. To address these challenges, this study investigates the energy scheduling problem in photovoltaic storage charging stations. This study develops a vehicle charging model and a multi-objective optimization framework to minimize total operating costs and load fluctuations. Furthermore, to enhance efficiency, an improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization (IMOPSO) algorithm is proposed. Three scheduling strategies are thoroughly analyzed: a conventional passive approach (Strategy 1), traditional MOPSO optimization (Strategy 2), and improved MOPSO optimization (Strategy 3). The results show that Strategy 3 significantly outperforms the other strategies, reducing total operating costs by 37.92% and load fluctuations by 40.35% compared to Strategy 1. Simulation results confirm the improved IMOPSO algorithm's effectiveness in addressing energy scheduling challenges in photovoltaic storage charging stations. The algorithm not only enhances the economic efficiency of photovoltaic storage charging stations but also achieves peak shaving and valley filling for the power grid. These results demonstrate its broad potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: Modeling Method for Hybrid Ripple Estimation of General PWM Converters Based on KBM Theory
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To address the problem of balancing the accuracy and efficiency of simulation models of PWM converters, a hybrid ripple estimation modeling method for general Pulse-Width-Modulated (PWM) converters is proposed. The method is to apply the Krylov-Bogoliubov-Mitropolsky (KBM) theory to the Piecewise State Space Averaging (PSSA) model of PWM converter, and to address the defects of the first-order ripple estimation model, an upgrade criterion of the ripple estimation model is proposed, so as to realize the variable-order ripple estimation of state variables. Modeling simulations of the three cases are performed based on the system modeling language Modelica, and the results indicate that the hybrid ripple estimation model provides the best fitting effect and the model run efficiency is improved compared with the detailed model.

articleTitle: A Low-Dimensional Optimization Method for Parallel Parking Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Optimization-based parking path planner can make full use of parking space, but its extensive computational consumption limits its practical application. This paper proposes a low-dimensional optimization path planning method, which accelerates the numerical computation process by reducing the number of the optimization variables and obstacle avoidance constraints. Since differential equations in the optimization-based planner require many discretize points to ensure numerical accuracy, the geometric characteristic of the optimal path is analyzed from a large amount of optimization results and further used to describe the parallel parking mission as a low-dimensional nonlinear programming problem that only consists of algebraic equations. As adjacent points on the parking path are connected by analytical curves, a simplified obstacle avoidance constraint is designed based on relative geometric position relationship between these curves and obstacle boundary lines. Based on this, a collision-free parking path can be optimized by verifying obstacle avoidance constraints only at the endpoints. Simulation results show that the optimized path is collision-free and the optimization process is accelerated by these techniques.

articleTitle: Research on Scanning Frequency and Broadband Impedance Spectroscopy Technology for Cable Defect Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Based on the statistical data of fine cable management of State Grid Corporation of China, the main causes of XLPE cable faults were analyzed in the statistical data of power cable faults, including mechanical damage, non-standard installation, insulation aging, manufacturing quality, and overvoltage damage. As a key demonstration area for the construction of a new power system, Xinjiang's social development demand for electricity and the scale of power transmission are constantly increasing. However, the existing problems are also obvious. For example, in the Xinjiang power grid, XLPE cable failures are mainly caused by mechanical damage (72.1%), improper installation (10.6%), insulation aging (8.4%), manufacturing defects (3.4%), and overvoltage damage (5.5%). The annual growth rate of power cable laying in Xinjiang is expected to exceed 35%, but special environmental conditions such as extreme low temperatures and large temperature differences between day and night accelerate cable insulation aging and defect exposure, leading to faults and safety accidents. According to data from Urumqi Power Supply Company in the past 5 years, cable accessory faults account for as high as 97%, with 110kV single core cable buffer layer faults being the most common. In order to solve the operation and maintenance problems of power cable systems in the special large temperature difference environment of Xinjiang region, this paper analyzes the broadband input impedance spectrum and its transmission characteristics at the beginning of the cable, studies the influence mechanism and degree of local defects on the cable impedance spectrum, and develops a new impedance spectrum data analysis method. It effectively separates the characteristic parameters that characterize the cable operating state parameters from the cable impedance spectrum, realizes the localization and state evaluation of cable local defects, and solves the problems of mechanical damage, non-standard installation, insulation aging, and manufacturing defects. The research results achieve timely detection and fault localization of cable operating defects.

articleTitle: Automatic Sorting System for Citrus with Fast Visual Recognition and Improved Multi-Criteria Clustering
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a fully automated fruit grading system designed for Chinese fruit farmers, utilizing industrial vision and clustering algorithm for rapid and precise sorting. This system consists of an image processing subsystem for dual vision detection of fruit appearance, a clustering subsystem optimized with an improved K-Means clustering algorithm, and a mechanical subsystem scheme of a two-degree-of-freedom linear module and a three-coordinate manipulator. This mechanical system efficiently handles loading, packing, and unloading small patches of fruits in multi-stations. The sorting process was based on visual detection and qualification of fruit shape, peel appearance, and weight, during which a fruit-shape-rating algorithm using Sobel edge detection was developed to precisely identify fruit contours and diameters. In the clustering grading process, a multi-level evaluation model, adhering to the NY/T-1190 standard, was established to assess fruit weight, shape, peel color, and defects. To optimize one-time boxing efficiency and overall profit of small-batch fruits, the enhanced K-Means algorithm employed dimensionless fruit parameters for clustering. Experiments showed that the system achieved a 97.4% accuracy in detecting fruit defects, a 5.2% improvement in edge detection, and an 89.9% grading accuracy, with a 10.3% increase in same-batch sorting efficiency for small batches of 72 fruits.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Management and Early Warning Technology of Food Science Laboratory Based on Multi Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Regarding the safety hazards in food science laboratories resulting from a multitude of instruments and equipment, as well as numerous flammable and explosive chemicals, by drawing upon advanced technologies such as the Internet of Things and multi-information fusion, a technology for distributed management, comprehensive health status assessment, and risk early warning of laboratories is proposed. By applying the D-S evidence theory to integrate and analyze information on personnel, environment, and instruments. Not only can this technology promptly detect temporary trigger faults and safety incidents such as fires, waterlogging, and gas leakage, but it can also promptly identify potential safety hazards caused by aging lines and excessive electricity consumption and issue early warnings in the first place. Compared with traditional laboratory monitoring methods, it features higher assessment accuracy and stronger risk control capabilities.

articleTitle: Towards Reliable Navigation for Intelligent Unmanned Surface Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel navigation system developed to tackle the challenge of unreliable navigation data during unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) operation. The system incorporates a method to determine the reliability index of the navigation system, which helps identify system uncertainties, and an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) based algorithm for USV trajectory recovery from the unreliable sensor data. Based on the determined reliability index, the system can quickly identify unreliable data, accurately assess risks associated with imprecise data, which enables it to generate a more dependable guidance route. The effectiveness and capabilities of this reliable navigation system have been validated through simulations and practical trials, highlighting its practical value and significance.

articleTitle: The Importance of Natural Gas and LNG in the Clean Energy Transition for International Oil Companies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: In the context of global energy security and environmental protection, all countries are accelerating the energy transition, and the international major oil companies have made positive responses in the transition to clean energy. In order to explore the important role of natural gas and LNG in the transition process of international oil companies, this paper analyzes the driving forces to promote the transition of energy structure to natural gas, describes the specific applications of natural gas and LNG in industry, power generation, transportation and other fields, and describes the specific strategies adopted by international oil companies such as Shell and BP in the transition process. The economic and environmental benefits of the natural gas transition are assessed and the challenges the oil industry faces in this development are noted.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Mid-Term and Long-Term Power Transmission Corridors Access to Beijing and New Power Transmission and Transformation Projects in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Under the goals of carbon peak and carbon neutrality, accommodating and integrating a high proportion of renewable energy is a key challenge we currently face. The power grid as a crucial bridge between power generation and consumption, plays a significant role in ensuring electricity supply, integrating renewable energy, and optimizing power dispatch. However, as electricity trading matures, traditional grid transmission and transformation project planning methods are no longer sufficient to meet the capacity assessment needs in the electricity market environment. Therefore, it is necessary to consider electricity market factors when planning grid investments to optimize the economic performance of the main grid. This paper utilizes an 8760-hour planning and simulation platform to analyze the 2035 main grid planning scheme around Beijing proposed by the North China Branch of the State Grid. Taking into account the power spot market environment and the long-term source-network-load characteristics of the Beijing-Tianjin-Tangshan area, it examines the economics of the mid-term and long-term access corridor planning scheme and the transmission and substation project around Beijing, providing strong support for the feasibility of the planning scheme.

articleTitle: A Branch-and-Price Algorithm for Unrelated Parallel Machine Scheduling to Minimize Total Weighted Completion Time
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper addresses an unrelated parallel machine scheduling problem, aiming to minimize the total weighted completion time. The problem is formulated into a set-partitioning model, and a branch-and-price algorithm is developed to solve it. To handle the pricing problem, a pseudo-polynomial dynamic programming and a polynomial-time heuristic are proposed. Furthermore, a greedy heuristic is designed to provide tight upper bounds. Numerical experiments on 200 benchmark instances with up to 100 jobs and 30 machines, highlight the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed algorithm, particularly for instances with a large number of machines.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Economic Feasibility of Power Substitution Potential at the Industrial Park Level Based on Mixed-Integer Linear Programming and Its Application in a Pharmaceutical Park
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: To address the lack of rapid and economical methods for assessing the power substitution potential of enterprises and industrial parks under the dual-carbon goals, this study employs a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) approach to construct a year-round, 8760-hour simulation and optimization model of the energy system at the industrial park level. A quantitative analysis framework for power substitution potential is proposed. Through a practical analysis of power substitution in a pharmaceutical park in Guizhou, it was found that compared with the traditional gas boiler solution, the optimized power substitution scheme using high-temperature heat pumps could save the target park approximately 95,000 RMB in annual energy costs, reduce unit energy cost by about 3%, and decrease unit energy-related carbon emissions by about 4%. This study provides a scientific method and simulation framework for quantitatively analyzing power substitution potential in industrial parks.

articleTitle: Phase-Aware Speech Enhancement with Dual-Stream Architecture and MetricGAN
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Many studies have explored how to utilize phase information. However, the extraction of the relationship between magnitude and phase remains inadequate. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a phase-aware dual-stream architecture model. The model includes an encoder and two downstream decoders. The two decoders are responsible for modeling magnitude and phase information, respectively. Moreover, in order to capture the implicit association between magnitude and phase, the model establishes a fusion module between the two decoders, allowing reference to predicted magnitude information during the process of predicting phase information. To avoid the compensation effect between magnitude and phase, the predicted magnitude spectrum is applied with a stop-gradient operator before magnitude fusion, thereby blocking phase related gradients from flowing into magnitude arguments. To discard the discrepancy between predicted PESQ and calculated PESQ, additional phase input is introduced to the discriminator, enabling discriminator to accurately simulate the PESQ calculation process. We achieves a PESQ score of 3.53 on the VoiceBank+DEMAND datasets, which indicates a certain improvement over previous work.

articleTitle: Deformation Analysis Method for Substation Expansion Joints Based on Multi-Scale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: As a crucial component in the power transmission system, the health status of substation expansion joints directly impacts the safe and stable operation of the entire power grid. This paper introduces a method based on multi-scale feature fusion for efficient and accurate analysis of the deformation of substation expansion joints. Initially, this method employs high-resolution image acquisition technology to capture surface morphological information of the expansion joints, and utilizes a multi-scale convolutional neural network to extract features from different scales. Subsequently, the multi-scale features are integrated through a feature fusion module, enhancing the model's ability to recognize subtle deformation patterns. Additionally, this paper incorporates time series analysis technology, modeling the dynamic behavior of the expansion joints in conjunction with historical data, thereby further improving prediction accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed multi-scale feature fusion method can effectively detect various deformation conditions of the expansion joints, including but not limited to excessive extension, compression, fatigue cracks, and corrosion, providing robust technical support for preventive maintenance of the power system. This research holds significant theoretical and practical value in enhancing the intelligent monitoring level of power equipment.

articleTitle: Study on the Measurement of Hydropower Feed-in Tariff based on Capacity Compensation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Hydropower is characterised by renewable energy, large-scale storage, low operating costs and low environmental pollution. However, there are some problems with the old hydropower, such as the lack of price adjustment mechanism, the linkage between price and capacity cost is not close enough, in this context, a province in the south-central A as an example, first of all, the development of hydropower in the province is analysed, and at the same time pointed out that there are a series of problems such as the low price of the backward thrust of the hydropower transmission process, and gave the corresponding solutions to these problems. Then, a method for analysing the competitiveness of hydropower export is proposed by backcasting the base price of coal power in the landing province and deducting the transmission and distribution price, and comparing it with the feed-in tariff of hydropower. And based on the element of capacity compensation, a feed-in tariff measurement model is proposed to present the real capacity cost of hydropower.

articleTitle: The Effects of a Knee-Joint Energy Harvester on Muscle Activation in the Human Lower Limbs Based on EMG Signal
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Knee-joint energy harvesters for the lower limb provide sustainable power for outdoor environments, addressing the limitations of portable devices and the high metabolic costs of batteries. Biomechanical energy is dissipated at the knee joint during the acceleration and deceleration phases of walking. Over the past two decades, researchers have designed numerous knee-joint biomechanical energy harvesters to capture this dissipated energy, generate electrical power, and reduce bioenergy consumption. However, the biomechanical effects of these harvesters on walking remain unclear, hindering further optimization. Therefore, this study aimed to explore the biomechanical effects using electromyography and gait analysis with knee-joint biomechanical energy harvesters. The results indicated that during the first negative work phase (0-20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) of walking with the powered exoskeleton in energy harvesting mode, the ampere torque generated by the closed-loop system reduced the activation of the vastus lateralis (VL) and rectus femoris (RF) muscles in the early stance phase by 12%. Furthermore, during the deceleration phase of the swing stage, the activation levels of these two muscles were significantly lower compared to other muscles.

articleTitle: A Study on the Detection of Sub-Metering Errors of Electrical Energy in Distribution Networks Based on Wavelet Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: The calculation of the error of sub-item metering of electric energy in the distribution network is conducive to improving the operational efficiency and energy management level of the distribution network, and the detection method of the error of sub-item metering of electric energy in the distribution network based on a wavelet neural network is studied. When improving operational efficiency and energy management level, calculating sub item measurement errors is extremely critical. This method utilizes the consolidation of sub item measurement data by merging units, and uses the dual laws of thermal and electrical energy to determine measurement errors. Using wavelet packet decomposition with db4 wavelet as the basis function, determine the characteristic frequency band with the highest energy value for the power measurement signal. Input the decomposed signal into a radial basis function neural network, which maps the input data using the radial basis function of the hidden layer and outputs the error detection result. The test results show that this method can accurately detect the error of the power sub-item metering in the distribution network, and the mean square error of the error detection of the power sub-item metering is less than 0.3.

articleTitle: Research on the Comprehensive Evaluation of the Power Market Trading Mechanism Based on the Fuzzy Hierarchy Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the comprehensive evaluation method of the trading mechanism of Chinese electricity market, and design a multi-level evaluation standard framework by fuzzy level analysis. The framework is based on five core considerations: liquidity, stability, economy, development coordination, and transparency, and is deeply developed into 12 secondary indicators and 24 specific assessments. The paper applies the evaluation model to the evaluation of trading mechanism of Gansu power market, and combined with the actual operation of Gansu power market, the results show that the overall evaluation level of trading mechanism of Gansu power market is “good”. Finally, this study highlights the importance of continuous optimization of the evaluation index system and suggests a future focus on the application of more diversified evaluation methods and technologies to accommodate the changing and evolving demands of the electricity market.

articleTitle: A Study of the Optimization of Magnet Power Supply Control Strategy for SC-200 Proton Accelerator Beam Transport Line
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: With the development of medical oncology, especially radiotherapy, proton therapy has emerged as a more effective and less damaging alternative to traditional treatment option. The necessity for higher precision and more rapid response times from the power supplies of proton accelerator beam transport lines increases with the extent and detail of the applications in question. In this paper, the transfer function of the SC-200 internal bunching fluid magnet power supply is derived and constructed on the basis of a number of fundamental principles. The LADRC feedback control algorithm was implemented, and the control parameters and outcomes were evaluated in comparison with those of the PID control algorithm, which is a standard technique employed in engineering applications. Practice has shown that The LADRC algorithm has been demonstrated to exhibit robust anti-interference capabilities, high processing speed, and stability. Consequently, the model is capable of identifying the optimal parameter settings for the construction of an accelerator beam transport line power supply.

articleTitle: Research on Planning and Optimization of Integrated Energy Systems for Zero-Carbon Industrial Parks Considering CCS-P2G Coupling
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Zero-carbon industrial parks are key to achieving regional energy decarbonization and economic development. This study proposes an optimization model integrating CCS-P2G technologies, enhancing carbon capture efficiency and renewable energy use. Through multi-timescale scheduling and scenario analysis, the model demonstrates improved economic and environmental performance while addressing operational uncertainties. The results validate significant energy cost savings and emission reductions, offering practical guidance for zero-carbon park planning and supporting global carbon neutrality goals.

articleTitle: RSS-YOLO: A Feature Fusion and Decoupled Object Detection Method in Remote Sensing Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Electrical Automation and Artificial Intelligence (ICEAAI)
abstract: Itis still challenging to detect objects in optical remote sensing satellite imagery because of large-scale and small-scale objects coexisting in the images and variations in object density, making multi-scale object detection challenging. Additionally, there is a sample imbalance issue between easy and hard samples. This study proposes an improved approach based on the YOLOv7-Tiny framework to address these problems.
